title: On a touch screen a first tap on a graph node selects it and shows its card
when: On a touch screen, taps a graph node on the canvas.
then: Expects the address unchanged, the node drawn as selected and its box in the keyboard layer outlined, and a card naming it; a tap on the canvas away from every box lets go; the card is one button named for opening the node, beside the let go button, and a tap on it opens the node. `isTap` reads a mouse as a click and a finger or a pen as a tap.

title: On a phone long IDs wrap, and tables and code blocks scroll in their own box
when: Reads the stylesheet's rules for tables, `.table-scroll`, code blocks and `.record-id`; then, on a phone, opens `/DM`, `/DM-SHOP`, `/DM-SHOP-UC01`, `/DM-SHOP-CMD01-H`, the Checks panel and the format page.
then: Expects tables, `.table-scroll` and code blocks in `.markdown` and `.spec-body` to scroll sideways (`overflow-x: auto`) and `.record-id` to wrap anywhere; and on each page every table outside a markdown body inside a `.table-scroll` box (but the ERD key and shortcut tables), every code block inside `.markdown` or `.spec-body`, and no inline width or least width over 288 px.

title: The theme-color meta follows the theme's --sheet token
when: Sets `--sheet` on the root.
then: Expects the meta to take it, changes it and expects the meta to follow.

title: On a touch screen every workbench target is at least 44 × 44 px, at any width
when: Reads `app/src/styles.css`.
then: Expects every rule with a pointer cursor to be covered by a coarse-pointer rule that sizes the control (or a `::before` stretched around it) to `--touch-target` (44 px), or to be touch-sized everywhere; the rule reads the controls of the page's chrome, while a canvas's nodes and cards meet the size by their laid-out size, large and zoomable.

title: Stability: the first load of the product, domain and record pages shifts nothing, also with slow fonts
when: Loads each page with the probes installed before its scripts, and once with the app's font files held back 2.5 seconds.
then: Expects no unexpected shift and the nav, the page bar, the header strip, the wiki card and the stage never to move.

title: Stability: moving between records through the nav, a link in the wiki card, a click on the stage, Back and quick find keeps the frame still
when: From the record page, moves through the nav to another domain, through a link in the wiki card, by clicking a graph box and then Back, and through quick find to `LA-EXP-UC07`; from the domain page scrolled half-way, follows a link in view and then goes Back.
then: Expects the frame not to move; from a page scrolled half-way, expects the new page never to be drawn at the old scroll, and Back to draw the page once, with the row that was at the top of the view back in its place.

title: Stability: switching the stage and collapsing, hiding or resizing a panel moves only it, the panels never overlap, and the focus recenters in the open space
when: At 1440 px on an aggregate's ERD stage with every panel open, measures the nav, the wiki card, the page bar and the stage; switches the stage with Ctrl+2, Ctrl+3 and Ctrl+1; collapses and shows the wiki card with Enter; widens the wiki card with Shift+Left on its resize handle.
then: Expects the card and the page bar to start after the nav and end inside the window, the card below the page bar, and the stage to fill the 1440 by 700 window behind them; on each step the nav, the page bar, the header strip and the panels that stay not to move, only the stage or the card changing; and the focus to sit in the open space after the card collapses, shows or widens.

title: Stability: folding a row and Expand all move only what is below
when: Opens and closes a row and uses Expand all and Collapse all in the wiki card on the domain page.
then: Expects the row, the section heading, the title and the frame to stay.

title: Stability: dragging a panel's edge follows the pointer, and folding by drag moves nothing on the far side
when: Drags the nav's and the wiki card's edges and folds the nav by drag.
then: Expects the panel dragged never to jump back, and the stage and the other panels not to move.

title: Stability: re-centering the graph at depth 1 to 3, changing depth and moving around the ERD keep the panels, the stage's tools and the canvas still
when: Re-centers twice at each depth from 1 to 3, changes the depth to 2, 3 and 1, goes from a domain's ERD to an aggregate's and an entity's and Back, and presses Right on an entity at a region's edge on the ERD.
then: Expects the page bar, the header strip, the stage's tools and the canvas and its drawing never to move or be mounted anew.

title: Stability: a live reload keeps what is in view
when: Changes a data file in the suite's copy of the data while the domain page's wiki card is scrolled half-way (a paragraph added to the domain's description, above the view) and while the Graph stage shows (a paragraph added to the record's goal).
then: Expects what was at the top of the view to stay there, the scroll box to keep its place, and the frame and the graph not to be drawn anew.

title: Stability: tooltips, quick find, the palette and the shortcuts sheet are placed before they show
when: Hovers the first two stage switch buttons on the Graph stage; opens quick find with Ctrl+K, types and closes it with Escape; opens the command palette with Ctrl+Shift+P and types; opens the shortcuts sheet with Ctrl+/ and searches it; opens the Checks panel from the nav and selects a problem; opens the Appearance popover from the nav.
then: Expects no unexpected shift: the nav, the page bar and the header strip never move, and the tooltip, the open dialog's search box and an open tool panel stay where they showed.

title: Stability: switching to a theme that differs only in color moves nothing
when: Switches from the default theme to Midnight through the Color theme pick (g t) on a record page on the Graph stage.
then: Expects no layout shift at all and no key element to move.

title: Stability: the mobile sheets at 375 px move nothing behind them
when: At 375 px wide with touch, opens and closes the nav drawer, the quick find sheet and the wiki card sheet.
then: Expects the top bar, the page and its title behind them not to move.

title: The first load reaches no React Flow and no ELK through static imports, so a record page opens on the wiki's code alone
when: Follows the static imports from the app's entry.
then: Expects no module of React Flow or ELK among them.

title: Stability: the nav, the first pane's bar and title never move while a page first loads
when: Loads the record page with the probes installed before its scripts and the app's font files held back 2.5 seconds, and lets it settle 4 seconds.
then: Expects no unexpected shift and the nav, the main area, the page bar, the header strip and the wiki card never to move.

title: The header strip's count is one text, so a new number never moves the text after it
when: Opens a requirement on the Graph stage at depth 1.
then: Expects the header strip's counts to be one text node, the last thing in the strip, and no count in the graph's toolbar.

title: Every scroll box keeps room for its scrollbar, so it never comes and goes with the content
when: Reads `app/src/styles.css`.
then: Expects more than five vertical scroll boxes, each setting `scrollbar-gutter: stable` or hiding its scrollbar, and names the line of any that does not.

title: Accessibility: Tab reaches every control and comes back round, with no trap
when: On a record page on the Graph stage, with the wiki card open, presses Tab until focus comes back to its first stop.
then: Expects it to get there, every stop to be drawn, and Shift+Tab to go back the same way.

title: Accessibility: the main tasks are done by keyboard alone, from the skip link to the theme
when: With the keyboard only: Tabs to the skip link; opens a record from the nav (Ctrl+Shift+E) and from quick find (`LA-PLT-UC05`); switches to the ERD stage from the page bar, then to Trace and the Graph with Ctrl+3 and Ctrl+1; collapses and shows the wiki card with Enter from the page and from the card's own button; Tabs between the graph's boxes and re-centers on one with Enter, steps out and in with Left and Right in the Tree view and with Up and Down in the Nested view; folds and unfolds a row on the domain page with Enter and Space; picks Midnight with g then t; and opens a domain from its card on the product page.
then: Expects `Skip to the page` as the first stop; each record opened at its address with its title shown; the ERD button pressed with focus kept on it and no stage button disabled, and the address moving to `stage=trace` and `stage=graph`; the wiki card gone and back each time; the address and focus following the box re-centered and each step out and in; the row's `aria-expanded` flipping and back; `data-theme` set to `midnight`; and each domain card one tab stop, Enter opening it.

title: Accessibility: focus after a move, and back on the opener when a dialog or a sheet closes
when: Walks the app in a browser with the keyboard alone: opens a record from quick find, collapses and shows the wiki card, re-centers the graph, picks a theme, opens and closes the palette and the shortcuts sheet, cancels the remove question, and at 375 px opens and closes the nav drawer and the wiki card sheet.
then: Expects focus off the body after quick find opens a record; after the wiki card collapses from the page, focus still on the page, and after its own collapse button, on the wiki card toggle; focus following the box that became the graph's center; focus back on the Graph stage button when the theme picker closes; focus inside the palette and the shortcuts sheet, Tab kept inside, and back on the wiki card toggle when each closes; focus on the remove question and on `Edit` after Cancel; and at 375 px focus back on the button that opened the nav drawer and the wiki card sheet.

title: Accessibility: a view, the wiki card and a theme changed by keyboard are each announced
when: With the keyboard only on a record page: switches to the ERD stage from the page bar and to Trace with Ctrl+3, collapses the wiki card with Enter and with Escape, shows it again, and picks Midnight with g then t.
then: Expects the announcer to say `ERD stage`, `Trace stage`, `Wiki card collapsed`, `Wiki card shown` and `Color theme: Midnight`.

title: Accessibility: axe finds every control's name holding its visible text, on every page and state
when: Opens each page and state (the product, domain, record and group pages, the Graph, ERD and Trace stages, Checks, Format, Appearance, quick find, the palette, the shortcuts sheet, a tooltip, the nav drawer, the quick find sheet and the wiki card sheet) at 1440 px and 375 px, in Lathe and High contrast, light and dark, and runs axe-core on each.
then: Expects no `label-content-name-mismatch` finding on any of them.

title: Accessibility: axe finds no control inside another, on every page and state
when: Opens each page and state (the product, domain, record and group pages, the Graph, ERD and Trace stages, Checks, Format, Appearance, quick find, the palette, the shortcuts sheet, a tooltip, the nav drawer, the quick find sheet and the wiki card sheet) at 1440 px and 375 px, in Lathe and High contrast, light and dark, and runs axe-core on each.
then: Expects no `nested-interactive` finding on any of them.

title: Accessibility: axe finds every scrolling box reachable by keyboard, on every page and state
when: Opens each page and state (the product, domain, record and group pages, the Graph, ERD and Trace stages, Checks, Format, Appearance, quick find, the palette, the shortcuts sheet, a tooltip, the nav drawer, the quick find sheet and the wiki card sheet) at 1440 px and 375 px, in Lathe and High contrast, light and dark, and runs axe-core on each.
then: Expects no `scrollable-region-focusable` finding on any of them.

title: Accessibility: axe finds every target at least 24 px or clear of its neighbors, on every page and state
when: Opens each page and state (the product, domain, record and group pages, the Graph, ERD and Trace stages, Checks, Format, Appearance, quick find, the palette, the shortcuts sheet, a tooltip, the nav drawer, the quick find sheet and the wiki card sheet) at 1440 px and 375 px, in Lathe and High contrast, light and dark, and runs axe-core on each.
then: Expects no `target-size` finding on any of them.

title: Accessibility: axe finds text contrast passing on every surface, in Lathe and High contrast, light and dark
when: Opens each page and state (the product, domain, record and group pages, the Graph, ERD and Trace stages, Checks, Format, Appearance, quick find, the palette, the shortcuts sheet, a tooltip, the nav drawer, the quick find sheet and the wiki card sheet) at 1440 px and 375 px, in Lathe and High contrast, light and dark, and runs axe-core on each.
then: Expects no `color-contrast` finding on any of them.

title: Every built-in theme holds its text and controls to AA in both modes, High contrast its text to AAA, and Lathe is the stylesheet unchanged
when: Audits each built-in theme's contrast in light and dark, and reads the stylesheet's tokens.
then: Expects no pair below AA in any built-in but Lathe, High contrast's text at 7:1 or more, and Lathe's tokens equal to the stylesheet's.

title: The arrow guard leaves a plain arrow with each control that uses arrows, and with nothing else
when: Asks the guard about an element of each excluded type (text and number fields, a radio button, a range, a textarea, a select, editable text, a tree, grid, menu, menu bar, listbox, combobox, tab list, radio group, slider, spin button, focusable splitter, menu button, modal dialog, a focused code block and scrolling region, and an element marked `data-arrows="own"`), something inside each, and plain elements.
then: Expects every excluded element and what is inside it to keep its arrows, and the page body, a plain button, a link, a checkbox, an input button, a paragraph, an unfocusable splitter, a button opening a dialog, a dialog that is not modal and what is inside it, and a link inside a scrolling region to give them to the stage.

title: From the page the plain arrows walk the Graph, ERD and Trace stages and are announced, stay with quick find and the Trace table, and walk from a nav link
when: On a use case, presses the arrows on the page body on the Graph, ERD and Trace stages, with Alt held, in quick find, on a focused nav link and on a link of the Trace table.
then: Expects each plain arrow from the page and from the nav link to move the focus by the stage's step (on the ERD from the use case's domain region to the region beside it and back, nothing to its left; on the Trace Right along a link to an obligation the use case reaches, Down and Up within its column, Left back to the use case) and the announcer to name the new focus by kind and title; Alt+arrow, quick find and the table to leave the focus where it was.

title: Accessibility: the arrow keys walk the stage from the wiki card and the page bar, and stay with quick find
when: On a record page on the Graph stage, clicks the wiki card's title and presses Left, then Right; switches to the ERD stage with Ctrl+2, focuses the page bar's wiki card toggle and presses Right; opens quick find, types a and presses Down.
then: Expects each arrow from the wiki card and the page bar to move the focus and the announcer to name it, the wiki card not to scroll, and quick find's Down to leave the focus where it was.

title: The ERD arrows move among a box's siblings by the picture, going on to the next area at its edge, and Out and In move between the levels
when: On a small fixed map of three regions (two aggregates and a closed aggregate in the first, one in the second, a closed region below), steps each way and Out and In from entities, aggregates, regions, a focus that picks out no box and the product; then ranks loose boxes by nearness and reading order.
then: Expects an entity to step within its aggregate, then on to the next aggregate and across into the next region, both ways, and nothing where nothing lies that way; aggregates and regions to walk among their own kind, Down onto a closed box below; Out from an entity to its aggregate, its region and the product, In to the first box inside, nothing In from a closed aggregate or an entity; from a focus that picks out no box, its scope's region as the start, and from the product Right and In to the first region, Up to the last, nothing Out; the nearest box one in the row or column before a nearer one off it; and reading order in rows.

title: On the Trace stage the arrows walk the All-at-once view: Up and Down within a column, Left and Right along the links
when: Walks the All-at-once graph of the model product from a requirement Up, Down, Left and Right, Out and In, onto a gap, and from no box.
then: Expects Up and Down to the boxes above and below in its column, Left and Out to its use case, Right and In to the nearest linked box in the next column, a gap said in words, and from no box any move to the first outcome.

title: W, A, S and D and vim's H, J, K and L walk as the arrows, Shift with them as Out and In, and text keeps its letters
when: Reads the walk key of each letter pressed plain, with Caps Lock, and with Ctrl, Cmd, Alt or Shift held; reads the graph step rows; asks the guard about text fields, a textarea, a select, editable text, a button, a link and text.
then: Expects W, A, S and D to walk Up, Left, Down and Right, plain or capital; Shift+Up and Shift+W to go Out and Shift+Down and Shift+S In; nothing with Ctrl, Cmd or Alt, nor Shift with Left or A, nor a letter like Q; the `walkLeft`, `walkDown`, `walkOut` and `walkIn` rows to list the arrow before the letter; every element that takes text to keep the letter, and a button, a link and text to give it to the stage.

title: W, A, S and D walk the Graph, ERD and Trace stages as the arrows do, plain only, and stay with a text field
when: On a use case, presses A and D on the page on the Graph stage, Shift+A and Alt+A, A and W in quick find, D on the ERD stage, and A and D on the Trace stage.
then: Expects A to step out to the capability and D back in, announced; Shift+A, Alt+A and the letters in quick find to leave the focus where it was; D on the ERD to move to the region beside the domain; and on the Trace D along a link to an obligation the use case reaches and A back to the use case.

title: In the browser, W, A, S and D walk the stage from the wiki card and are typed in quick find
when: On a record page on the Graph stage, clicks into the wiki card and presses A, then D, then Shift+A; presses Shift+W, Shift+S, Shift+Up and Shift+Down; opens quick find and types wasd.
then: Expects A and D each to move the focus and the announcer to name it, and Shift+A to leave it; Shift+W to go out and Shift+S in, Shift+Up back out to the same parent and Shift+Down in again; and quick find to hold `wasd` with the focus unchanged.

title: Shift+Up and Shift+Down, Shift+W and Shift+S, and the toolbar's Out and In go out and in on the Graph, ERD and Trace stages
when: On a use case, presses Shift+Up and Shift+S on the Graph stage and clicks Out and In, then Shift+Left and Shift+A; on the ERD presses Shift+Down and Shift+W and clicks Out; on the Trace presses Shift+Down and Shift+Up, and clicks In.
then: Expects the Graph out to the capability and back in, nothing on Shift+Left or Shift+A; the ERD in to an aggregate, out to the domain and the product; the Trace in along a link to an obligation the use case reaches, out back to the use case and in again, each announced.

title: Every page has its own address, and back and forward move between pages
when: Parses addresses with and without the spec index, opens `/DM-SHOP-UC01-R01` directly, follows the menu's Shopping link and its Checks link, then goes Back twice and Forward once.
then: Expects `/DM` a product page, `/DM-SHOP` a domain page (a record page without the index), a record ID a record page, `/DM-SHOP/domain-model/aggregate` a group, `/` the products, and `/specs/DM/DM-SHOP/graph`, `/format`, `/settings/appearance` and `/nothing-here` missing; the heading `The basket shows the new item` on the direct open; the address `/DM-SHOP`, then `/DM-SHOP?panel=checks` with the Checks region open; and Back and Forward showing Shopping, the record, then Shopping again.

title: A key another shortcut has shows at once, naming it, with Swap and Cancel
when: Records Ctrl+Shift+M (Open Checks) for the navigation, cancels, records it again and swaps, then adds Ctrl+W to Open Checks.
then: Expects "Ctrl+Shift+M is already “Open Checks”." with Swap focused, Cancel to change nothing, Swap to give the navigation Ctrl+Shift+M and Open Checks Ctrl+B, and Ctrl+W refused with its reason.

title: Recording a key works from the keyboard: Escape cancels without closing the sheet, and the key pressed reaches no command
when: Adds a key to Step left, presses Shift alone and then Escape, adds again and presses y, and reads the tree's Expand the row.
then: Expects the recorder named for its shortcut, Shift alone to wait, Escape to cancel with the sheet still open, y added to Step left with no command run, and Expand the row shown as fixed.

title: Edit a record with the keyboard, and focus comes back to its actions
when: In Chromium, opens a record, reaches its Edit by Tab and presses Enter, adds ", by keyboard" to the title, reaches Save by Tab and presses Enter.
then: Expects focus on the title input when the form opens, the form gone after saving, "Saved" and the record's ID announced, focus back on Edit, and the heading showing the new title.

title: A change naming read models reads again only their reads; the checks' run, only the problems and coverage
when: Opens a command handler's page, changes its title behind the page, and sends a change naming the command handler's table and the command and record summaries read models; then a change naming only the checks' read models.
then: Expects the new title on the page with only the command's and the record summaries' reads made again, then only the problems and coverage reads.

title: After a write, the page reads again only the read models the write touched
when: With the channel open, reloads after a write whose change comes after its answer, then after one whose change came first; then reloads with no channel open, and with a channel whose change never comes.
then: Expects each write's reload to wait for its change and mark only the read models it names, moving the version once; and every read model marked when no channel is open or no change comes within the wait.

title: Appearance, linked from the nav, offers light, dark or system too
when: With Dark stored, opens Demo shop, follows the nav's Appearance link and picks System, then Light.
then: Expects the nav's Appearance link to open `?panel=appearance` over the Graph stage with Dark checked, System to remove `data-mode` and store `system`, and Light to set `data-mode` to `light`.

title: Appearance lists the five built-in themes, each previewed in its own colors
when: Opens Appearance, points at Graphite's preview, leaves the list, then uses Graphite.
then: Expects five themes in the Themes list, each with a preview drawn in its own tokens (Workshop's `--paper` `#F6F0E6`) and Use Lathe pressed; pointing at Use Graphite to set `data-theme` to `graphite`, leaving the list to put back `lathe`, and a click on Use Graphite to keep `graphite`.

title: A copy of a theme is edited live, renamed, reset and deleted
when: Opens Appearance and duplicates Workshop, then changes a color, the text size, radius, density, motion and a font, renames the copy, resets it and deletes it.
then: Expects the editor at `?panel=theme&theme=custom-workshop-copy` with the copy in use, its colors grouped as Surfaces, Text, Borders, Accent, Signals, Graph and Depth with light and dark values side by side; each change in the theme's stylesheet at once (`--steel: #123456`, `--text-size: 17px`, `--panel-radius: 12px`, `--density: 0.5`, `--motion-speed: 0ms`, the system font); the name Shop floor stored; Reset to Workshop putting back `--steel: #9C3F17` and keeping the name; and Delete, once confirmed, going back to `?panel=appearance` with five themes and Lathe in use.

title: A color below WCAG AA while editing gets a warning beside its swatch
when: Duplicates Lathe, sets the light Muted text to `#B0B0B0`, then enters a value that is not a color.
then: Expects two contrast warnings beside the swatch, and the value `red; } body { display: none` marked `aria-invalid` with nothing of it in the theme's stylesheet.

title: A theme exports as a versioned file and imports back, and anything but known tokens is refused
when: On Appearance, imports a theme file of an unknown version, then a valid one named Shared.
then: Expects the file of version 9 refused with an alert naming `version 9`, the other announced as `Added “Shared”.`, six themes listed, and the stored theme `custom-shared` named Shared with the file's light colors.

title: Scroll to zoom, from Appearance or the palette, switches what scroll does on every stage
when: Opens a domain's graph with Appearance open, scrolls the canvas, turns Scroll to zoom on and scrolls again, scrolls with the Control key down, pinches, scrolls the ERD, then runs Turn scroll to zoom on or off from the palette.
then: Expects the switch off and the key reading `Scroll pans` while a scroll pans with the zoom unchanged; once on, `true` stored, the key reading `Scroll zooms`, the line saying Cmd or Ctrl with scroll pans, a scroll zooming in, Ctrl with scroll panning and a pinch zooming; the ERD zooming in on a scroll; and the palette command storing `false`, the switch off and the key reading `Scroll pans` again.

title: Color theme previews each theme as it is arrowed to; Enter keeps it and Escape puts back the one before
when: Opens the picker with g then t, arrows down to Workshop, then presses Escape.
then: Expects Lathe in use with its stylesheet stored for the early script; the picker listing Lathe, High contrast, Workshop, Midnight and Graphite with Lathe selected; Workshop shown with its stylesheet while `lathe` stays the stored choice; and Escape closing the picker and putting Lathe and its stylesheet back.

title: Light, dark or system is a command and a choice on Appearance
when: Runs the light, dark or system command from the palette (Ctrl+Shift+P), arrows to Dark and presses Enter.
then: Expects the picker to offer System, Light and Dark, the highlighted option to apply at once, Enter to keep Dark and store it, and the theme's stylesheet to apply the dark set under `data-mode="dark"` whatever the system says.

title: The shortcuts sheet and the command palette are searchable, and the palette runs commands
when: On a use case, presses ? and searches the shortcuts sheet for `hide the navigation`; types ? in quick find; opens the command palette with Ctrl+Shift+P, filters to `trace stage` and runs it; searches the palette for `all rows`.
then: Expects the sheet's Navigate, View, Graph and Lists groups and Command palette shown as `Ctrl+Shift+P`, the search leaving the Show or hide the navigation row and no Graph group; ? typed into quick find with no sheet opened; the palette starting at `>`, Trace stage first with `Alt+T` and Enter moving to `?stage=trace`; and `all rows` finding Expand all rows on this page and Collapse all rows on this page.

title: A stage hidden while the next one loads stops answering its commands at once, and answers again once shown
when: With a stage that answers Frame the focus under a Suspense boundary beside the next stage, runs the command while the stage shows, while the next stage loads and hides it, and once it shows again.
then: Expects the command to run while the stage is shown, to find no handler while it is hidden, and to run again once it shows.

title: The palette shows each command's keys right-aligned in kbd styling
when: Opens the command palette on a record's page.
then: Expects each palette row to end in a right-aligned `<kbd>` with `aria-keyshortcuts`, and a command without keys to show none.

title: Quick find ranks matches and opens one with the keyboard
when: Ranks records and domains by ID and title, then opens quick find from the nav's Go to button, types, moves down with the arrow key and opens the second result with Enter.
then: Expects `dm-shop` to rank DM-SHOP first, `basket` to find DM-SHOP-A1 and `shopping` to lead to `/DM-SHOP`; each result to show its kind chip, one its trail from Demo shop; the combobox to name the highlighted option; and Enter to move the address to the second result and close the overlay.

title: Quick find searches the current space only
when: Ranks quick find's items in Notebook's space, then opens Demo shop, types `note` and then `n` in quick find, and walks the results with the arrow keys.
then: Expects only the current space's records among the matches, none of another product's and no groups, walked as one list.

title: Quick find finds kinds and checks by name and leads to their pages
when: Ranks "Kind: Use case" and a check by its name, and a check a problem names before the reference loads; then types in quick find and opens a check's page with Enter.
then: Expects `Kind: Use case` to rank first and lead to `?page=format/kinds/use_case`, `event-not-by` to find its check, `not-proved` to be found before the reference loads, and Enter on `Check: not-pro` in quick find to open `/DM?page=format/checks/not-proved`.

title: A highlighted record previews on the stage and in the wiki card; Escape puts it all back, Enter commits
when: On a record's Graph stage, opens quick find from the Go to button and types a record's title; presses Escape; opens it again and presses Enter; then opens the commands.
then: Expects the graph centered on the highlighted record and the card showing it as a summary while the address and the header strip stay; after Escape the old center, the card's whole page and focus on the Go to button; after Enter the address moved there; and no preview for a command.

title: Quick open is a dialog with a combobox over a listbox, switched by ">", and focus returns
when: Opens quick open by its shortcut, types, presses Tab, types ">" and a command, deletes it, presses Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P while open and clicks the dimmed stage.
then: Expects a modal dialog named Quick find with a combobox that controls the listbox and names the highlighted option, Tab kept in the box, the dialog named Command palette with each command's keys after ">", the box reset to ">" by the shortcut, and focus back on the opener when it closes.

title: The shortcuts sheet matches the hints
when: Resolves the keymap's Switch to commands, opens the shortcuts sheet in Demo shop, then focuses Notebook in the rail by keyboard.
then: Expects one Switch to row per product with the keys its tooltip shows.

title: The record format is a palette command and a link in the shortcuts sheet, not a nav footer link
when: Opens Demo shop, looks for Record format in the nav, follows the shortcuts sheet's Record format link, then searches the palette for it.
then: Expects no Record format link in the nav, the shortcuts sheet's link to open `/DM?page=format` and close the sheet, and `record format` in the palette to find only the Record format command.

title: The native menus are File, Edit, View, Window and Help, each app command item sending its ID
when: Builds the menu template for a Mac and elsewhere, and clicks Help › Keyboard Shortcuts.
then: Expects the menus appMenu, File, Edit, View, Window and Help on a Mac and the same without the app menu elsewhere; View holding reload, developer tools, zoom and full screen; and Help holding Record Format and Keyboard Shortcuts, which runs `showShortcuts`.

title: In the running desktop app, Help › Keyboard Shortcuts opens the app's shortcuts sheet
when: Runs the real desktop shell, hidden, on a temporary product folder (macOS only) and sends Help › Keyboard Shortcuts to the page by its command ID.
then: Expects Help › Keyboard Shortcuts, sent by its command ID, to have opened the shortcuts sheet.

title: A menu choice sent by ID runs the app command
when: Stands in for the preload's `onCommand`, sends `toggleNav` twice and an unknown ID.
then: Expects the nav collapsed and expanded again and nothing else to happen, then expects the app to stop listening when it unmounts.

title: With no keys sent, no app command item has an accelerator but the menu's own, so every key reaches the app's keymap
when: Builds the menu template for a Mac, clicks each app command item, and reads each command's keys and key presses for a Mac and elsewhere.
then: Expects one item per menu command, each with only the accelerator its command declares and sending its ID; each command in the app's keymap (`app/src/shell/keymap.ts`) with keys among its default bindings; and the key presses for those keys read by the keymap as that binding, on a Mac and elsewhere.

title: The menu shows the person's first key of each command that can be an accelerator, never registered, and the menu's own keys stay
when: Turns keys into accelerators on a Mac and elsewhere, then builds the menu for a Mac with keys sent for the navigation, the shortcuts sheet, the record format and New Tab.
then: Expects Shift+Cmd+P, Ctrl+Super+I, Alt+Left, Ctrl+Plus and F8 but nothing for a plain key or a sequence; Cmd+J and Cmd+/ shown unregistered, none on Record Format, and New Tab keeping its own Cmd+T.

title: Open Recent opens the folder chosen from it
when: Builds the menu template for a Mac with the recent folders `/a` and `/b` and clicks `/b`, then builds it with none.
then: Expects File to start with Open Product Folder… on `CmdOrCtrl+O` and hold Close; Open Recent to list `/a`, `/b`, a separator and Clear Menu, `/b` opening that folder; and with no recent folders one disabled No Recent Folders item.

title: Settings… (Cmd+,) sits in the app menu on macOS and in File elsewhere
when: Builds the native menus for macOS and for another platform and clicks Settings….
then: Checks About Lathe and Settings… (Cmd+,) in the app menu on macOS and in File and Help elsewhere, with no Check for Updates; File › Open Records In with the current editor checked; and View › Tabs, with new, close, duplicate, next, previous, back and forward, their keys owned by the menu and every tab command sent by ID.

title: The running desktop window hides the system title bar, and the page draws its own 38 px bar
when: Runs the real desktop shell, hidden, on a temporary product folder (macOS only) and reads the window's title bar style and the page's own title bar.
then: Expects a hidden title bar style and the page's own bar 38 px high, its center starting with Lathe, with the buttons Go back, Go forward, the command center for quick find, Show or hide the navigation and Show or hide the chat with Claude.

title: Each platform's window has no system title bar, with its controls over the app's own 38 px bar
when: Builds the window options for macOS, Windows and Linux.
then: A hidden title bar everywhere, the traffic lights centered in 38 px on macOS with no overlay, and elsewhere an overlay of the shell and ink colors, 38 px high.

title: With window.latheDesktop the title bar sits above the shell, with room for each platform's window controls
when: Opens a record without `window.latheDesktop`, then with it on macOS and on Windows.
then: Expects no title bar and no `data-title-bar` in a browser; on macOS a `desktop-title-bar is-mac` banner right before the app shell, with `data-title-bar` set; and on Windows the bar marked `is-overlay`.

title: In the desktop app a record offers its file actions and a native menu, the page reports its errors, and full screen drops the traffic lights' room
when: Opens a Demo shop record in the desktop app on macOS, then enters and leaves full screen.
then: Expects the error count sent for the Dock badge to be Demo shop's and the workspace's errors (2), none of Notebook's; and the title bar, marked `is-mac`, to add `is-full-screen` in full screen and drop it after.

title: Back and forward follow the app's history and are disabled at its ends
when: Stands in for the Navigation API.
then: With no page either way both buttons are disabled; as pages are added behind and ahead, each enables and its click goes back or forward in the history.

title: The command center names the page and opens quick find
when: Opens a record.
then: Expects the command center to read "Lathe — " and the record's heading, and a click on it to put focus in quick find.

title: The layout toggle runs the navigation command and shows whether the nav shows
when: Clicks the navigation toggle twice, then narrows the window to 600 px.
then: Expects the nav to collapse and expand, with the toggle's `aria-pressed` following; and at 600 px the toggle to say the nav is collapsed for space, unpressed and marked `is-crowded`.

title: The title bar in a real window
manual_reason: Manual because it watches the window's own controls and the system's gestures, which only a person at the screen sees. Run it after changing `desktop/src/chrome.ts` or `app/src/shell/DesktopTitleBar.tsx`.
when: In the desktop app, drags the title bar between its controls, double-clicks it there, then clicks each of its controls.
then: The drag moves the window, the double-click zooms it (or minimizes it, if the system's setting says so), and each control acts without moving the window.

title: The page sends its theme's chrome colors, and the shell applies them to the window
when: Runs the real desktop shell, hidden, on a temporary product folder (macOS only) and reads the chrome colors the page sent to the window.
then: Expects the chrome's background and foreground each an uppercase `#RRGGBB` color.

title: The main process applies only valid theme colors to a window's chrome
when: Applies a valid chrome to a stand-in window on macOS and on Windows.
then: Expects on macOS the colors normalized to `#0A0F12` and `#EEEEEE` and only the background set, with no overlay; on Windows the background set and the controls' overlay drawn in the background and foreground colors, 38 px high.

title: The window's chrome follows the theme
when: Stands in for `setChrome`, opens the app.
then: Expects the Lathe theme's shell and ink; then chooses Midnight and expects its shell, every color an opaque `#rrggbb`.

title: In a browser, without window.latheDesktop, no title bar is drawn
when: Opens a record without `window.latheDesktop`, then with it on macOS and on Windows.
then: Expects no title bar and no `data-title-bar` in a browser; on macOS a `desktop-title-bar is-mac` banner right before the app shell, with `data-title-bar` set; and on Windows the bar marked `is-overlay`.

title: A new desktop window shows its launch view until the page has its specs
when: Runs the real desktop shell, hidden, on a temporary product folder (macOS only) and watches the launch view until the page has its specs.
then: Expects the launch view to have said `Opening Smoke Shop…` and to have lifted.

title: The launch view names the product and steps on as the page's specs arrive
when: Builds the launch view for Tool Library, and steps the launch from the page's `data-specs` values `ready`, `error` and others.
then: Expects the launch view `Opening Tool Library…` in the window's colors with no buttons, and the launch to step to ready on `ready`, to the error page on `error`, and to wait on anything else.

title: The error page shows the engine's message with Retry, Open Another Folder and Reveal in Finder
when: Builds the error page for Tool Library with a padded message on macOS, with an empty message and on Windows, and reads the engine's message from the app server's answers.
then: Expects the error page headed `Lathe couldn't open Tool Library` with the trimmed message, the folder under `~`, and Retry (primary), Open Another Folder… and Reveal in Finder (Show in File Explorer on Windows); a stand-in message when the engine said nothing; and the app server's `error` read as the message, or `GET /api/product/list-products answered <status>.` when it gives none.

title: A launch, error or About page runs only the buttons it shows
when: Asks the error page and the launch view to run Retry, Reveal, an action the error page does not show, and an action that is not a string.
then: Expects Retry and Reveal to run from the error page, and an action the page does not show, any action on the launch view and an action that is not a string to be refused.

title: The About window shows the versions and links to the repo and the record format
when: Builds the About model with its versions, once with no engine version, and passes it to the page as JSON.
then: Expects About's versions Version, Engine, Electron, Chromium and Node.js, an engine with no version shown as `unknown`, its two actions `open-repo` and `open-reference`, and the model passed to the page as JSON unchanged.

title: About Lathe sits in the app menu on macOS and in Help elsewhere, with no Check for Updates
when: Builds the native menus for macOS and for another platform and clicks About Lathe.
then: Checks About Lathe and Settings… (Cmd+,) in the app menu on macOS and in File and Help elsewhere, with no Check for Updates; File › Open Records In with the current editor checked; and View › Tabs, with new, close, duplicate, next, previous, back and forward, their keys owned by the menu and every tab command sent by ID.

title: The built icons cover every platform and size, and the Dock shows the 1024 px icon
when: Reads the built icon files, then runs the real desktop shell, hidden, on a temporary product folder (macOS only) and reads the Dock icon.
then: Expects the `.icns` and `.ico` headers, a PNG of each Linux size from 16 to 1024 px at that size, a 1024 px DEV icon, and the Dock showing `build/icon.png` at 1024 by 1024 px.

title: The app icon reads at every size and in light and dark Docks, with a DEV band in development
manual_reason: Manual because it watches the Dock, Finder, the system's menus and the look of the icon, which only a person at the screen sees. Run it after changing `desktop/src/main.ts`, `desktop/build/icon.svg` or `app/src/shell/desktopRecord.tsx`.
when: Runs `npm --prefix desktop run dev`, then `npm --prefix desktop run pack` and opens the packed app from `desktop/release/`, in light and in dark appearance.
then: In development the Dock shows the icon with a DEV band; the packed app's icon is crisp in the Dock, in Finder's list view (16 px) and in Cmd+Tab.

title: The Dock menu's New Window runs Open Product Folder
when: Builds the Dock menu and clicks its one item.
then: Expects the Dock menu to hold only New Window, and a click on it to run Open Product Folder once.

title: The Dock menu's New Window opens a folder, and every folder opened is listed there
manual_reason: Manual because it watches the Dock, Finder, the system's menus and the look of the icon, which only a person at the screen sees. Run it after changing `desktop/src/main.ts`, `desktop/build/icon.svg` or `app/src/shell/desktopRecord.tsx`.
when: With the packed app, opens a folder, then right-clicks the Dock icon and chooses New Window.
then: The Dock menu lists the folders opened, and New Window opens the folder picker.

title: The Dock badge counts the focused product's check errors and takes only whole counts
when: Turns error counts into badge text, picks the badge across the focused and last focused windows and a reload, and parses counts the page reports.
then: Expects the badge empty at 0, the count up to 999 and `999+` above; the focused window's count, else the window focused last, an unreported window as nothing and a new count after a reload; and only whole counts from 0 up taken from the page.

title: The graph is reached from the page's Graph stage, Ctrl+2 and the palette, never from the nav
when: Opens the Shopping domain, looks for a Graph item in the open and the collapsed nav, switches to the ERD stage and back with Ctrl+1, and searches the palette for the Graph stage.
then: Expects no Graph item in the open nav or the rail; the stage switch's ERD button moving to `?stage=erd` with a Graph button beside it, Ctrl+1 moving back to `?stage=graph`, and the palette's first match for `graph stage` the Graph stage command.

title: In the nav, a capability is a link heading its use cases, and a stage or kind folder only folds
when: Unfolds Shopping in the nav, then its Use cases stage, then Interaction design.
then: Expects Use cases as a button that folds with no link, listing the capability itself as a link to its page (the stage holds only capabilities), and a kind folder (Flows) as a button that folds with no link.

title: On the domain page, a capability heading its use cases links to its page, and the stage and kind headings are not links
when: Opens the Shopping domain's page.
then: Expects no link in any stage or kind heading, and the capability's row a link to its page.

title: A selected row is the whole row
when: Opens a domain page and a record page.
then: Expects one selected nav row each, the row holding the current link (and the domain's fold chevron), indented by its depth; and in the stylesheet the row spanning the panel with padding for its depth, the selection tint and steel text, no inset bar, no indent from the lists, the whole-row hover tint and the 1 px keyboard outline.

title: The menu lists each product and its domains beside the Tools section
when: Renders the app with two products.
then: Checks the Tools section and no Diagrams section, each product in the rail, and the current space's domains as links in the panel.

title: The nav collapses to a rail with tooltips, remembered
when: Collapses the nav.
then: Expects the rail's icons with names and tooltips and the choice remembered on the next page, then opens it again from the rail.

title: On a narrow screen the nav is a full-screen sheet
when: With a narrow screen, opens the nav sheet from the menu button.
then: Expects focus on the Go to button, closes it with Escape (focus back on the button), with a click outside, and by choosing a page.

title: The nav's rail has no Graph item
when: Opens the Shopping domain, looks for a Graph item in the open and the collapsed nav, switches to the ERD stage and back with Ctrl+1, and searches the palette for the Graph stage.
then: Expects no Graph item in the open nav or the rail; the stage switch's ERD button moving to `?stage=erd` with a Graph button beside it, Ctrl+1 moving back to `?stage=graph`, and the palette's first match for `graph stage` the Graph stage command.

title: Nav sections fold, the current place opens and is marked, with badges and a footer
when: Opens Shopping and folds Tools, opens the Checks panel, then the Paying domain, then Shopping again.
then: Expects no heading for the current space, its overview first, folds a section, opens a page in a folded section and expects it open, opens a domain page and expects it marked current, and checks the tooltip on a long name, the Checks badges and the footer.

title: The rail lists the products in order with their icons or monograms
when: Opens Demo shop in a workspace of three products: one with an icon too long to show, one with none, and one with an emoji icon.
then: Expects the rail's links Alpha beta, Demo shop and Notebook in ID order, marked `AB` (a monogram, its icon too long), `DM` and `📓` (an icon), with no rule and no other link after them.

title: The rail marks the current space with an accent bar
when: Opens a Notebook record in a workspace of several products and reads the stylesheet.
then: Expects Notebook's rail link marked `aria-current` and `is-current`, Demo shop's not, and the stylesheet drawing a bar before `.space-item[aria-current]`.

title: Choosing a space scopes the nav to its domains, folders and groups
when: Opens Demo shop, unfolds Shopping and its Use cases stage, then chooses Notebook in the rail.
then: Expects the current space's domains; unfolding a domain, then its Use cases stage, shows its capabilities in order, with no Capabilities folder between. Expects the product's groups and none of another product's; choosing another space swaps them.

title: Choosing a space opens its last page this session
when: Opens a Demo shop use case, chooses Notebook in the rail and opens its Notes record, then chooses Demo shop and Notebook again.
then: Expects Demo shop to reopen at `/DM-SHOP-UC01` and Notebook at `/NF-NOTE`.

title: The rail's link to a space names the last page opened in it
when: Moves between two spaces.
then: Expects each space's rail link to name the page left in it.

title: Alt and a number switch spaces, and the palette has Switch to commands
when: Opens Alpha beta in a workspace of three products, presses Ctrl+Shift+M, then searches the palette for `switch to` and runs the second command.
then: Expects Ctrl+Shift+M to open `/AB?panel=checks`; the palette to list Switch to Alpha beta, Demo shop and Notebook with `Alt+1`, `Alt+2` and `Alt+3`; and the second to open `/DM`.

title: The rail stays in the narrow-screen drawer
when: On a narrow screen, opens the nav sheet.
then: Expects the rail, and switches space from it.

title: A space's index holds only its product's records, links, parts, coverage and problems, and the records and problems of no product
when: With a link and a named ID from Demo shop into Notebook.
then: Expects each space's index to hold its own records, parts and those of no product, no link into the other, its own coverage, and its problems with the workspace's.

title: Each product has its own graph map
when: Builds Demo shop's graph map from its space's index with a record of no product and a link into Notebook, then opens a Demo shop use case on the Graph stage.
then: Expects Demo shop's map to have Demo shop as its single root and only its nodes, a record of no product to root a map of its own, and the graph to draw nothing of Notebook.

title: No screen of one space shows another product: the wiki card, text, the format reference and Checks
when: Opens a Demo shop use case that links to and names a Notebook record, then the format reference's Domain page, then Notebook's Checks panel.
then: Expects the wiki card to list no link into Notebook and Notebook's domain ID named in a text field to be plain text, the reference to count and link only the space's records, and Notebook's Checks to name nothing of Demo shop.

title: Under the space, the nav lists its domains, each holding Define, Design and Open questions
when: Opens Demo shop and unfolds Shopping in the nav.
then: Expects Shopping folded by default with no folders listed, and unfolded into Domain model 4, Use cases 1, Interaction design 2, Technical specification 2, Test plan 2 and Open questions 1.

title: The product shows Shared only when it holds anything, before its domains
when: Opens Demo shop with a pattern and records both domains use, unfolds Shared and its Use cases, then opens Notebook.
then: Expects one Shared folder before the domains holding the product's own stages (the pattern, and the value object and view both domains use), a pattern rule test under its rule, the pattern under Use cases, the product's open questions as a group of their own, and no Shared for a product that shares nothing.

title: Stages and folders fold one level at a time, each with its count
when: Unfolds Shopping, then its Domain model, Interaction design and Endpoints, and Open questions, then folds Interaction design again.
then: Expects Domain model to open into Aggregates, Specifications, Read models and Terms, one each, still folded; Interaction design into Flows and Endpoints, Endpoints listing `POST /basket/items`; Open questions listing `What happens to a basket overnight?` linked to `/DM-SHOP-Q01`; and Interaction design folded again to hide its folders.

title: A stage or folder with no records is left out of the nav
when: Unfolds Paying, which holds only an aggregate, a use case and its flow, then its Interaction design.
then: Expects a domain with an aggregate, a use case and its flow to show Domain model, Use cases and Interaction design, no Technical specification or Test plan, and its Interaction design to list Flows and no empty Endpoints folder.

title: The current page's branch opens itself
when: Opens a command handler's page, then the Paying domain's page.
then: Expects the command handler's page to open Shopping's Command handlers folder with addToBasket current, and the Paying domain page to open its domain (Fold Paying expanded), kept in session storage as `domain:DM-PAY`.

title: The product shows Shared only when it has patterns
when: Opens a pattern rule's page in Demo shop with a pattern.
then: Expects the nav to open the product's own Use cases of Demo shop, listing the pattern Audited action.

title: A capability's flows and tests sit in their folders, its use cases under it
when: Opens a second use case under the Buying capability.
then: Expects the nav's Use cases of Shopping to open and list only the capability Buying.

title: In the nav, Technical specification and Test plan fold into kind folders with counts, one level at a time, folded for the session
when: Unfolds Shopping, then Technical specification, Test plan and its Use case tests folder.
then: Expects each stage to open into its kind folders with counts, still folded, a kind folder's row to only fold, and what is open kept in session storage only.

title: A test's or a technical record's page opens its branch through its stage and kind folder
when: Opens an invariant test's page, then a table's page.
then: Expects an invariant test's page to open Invariant tests with its row current, and a table's page Tables.

title: Records with no owner sit in the one domain that uses them, or else in Shared by stage, and a specification in its domain's Domain model
when: Opens the product's page and nav, then a domain's page.
then: Expects the value object both domains use in the product's Shared, in the nav and on the product page; the view and integration one domain uses in its Interaction design; and the specification in its Domain model.

title: The product page lists the records it shares under Shared, in their stages, each in its stage's color
when: Opens the product page of a product whose two domains use one value object and one view.
then: Expects Shared to list them in the domain model and interaction design stages, in those stages' colors, and none of a domain's own records.

title: The rail shows with two or more products; with one there is none, and the product heads the nav
when: Opens the app on a workspace of three products, then on one of a single product, expanded and collapsed.
then: Expects the rail with three; with one no rail and no space list, the product's name and icon as the nav's first row, and the collapsed nav's buttons with no spaces.

title: A space's last page is remembered for the session only
when: Opens `/DM-SHOP-UC01`, then Notebook from the rail and its Notes page.
then: Expects session storage `lathe:space-pages` to hold `DM` at `/DM-SHOP-UC01` and `NF` at `/NF-NOTE`, and nothing under that key in local storage.

title: What is folded is remembered for the session, and every record is listed without sections
when: Unfolds Shopping's Test plan in the nav, then opens the product's page with Checks over it.
then: Expects Test plan of Shopping still unfolded on the product's page with Checks over it, and nothing kept under `lathe:nav-folders` in local storage.

title: The product lists its standards under Shared, beside its patterns
when: Opens the Demo shop product and unfolds its Shared folder, its Technical specification and its Standards.
then: Expects one Shared folder counting 5, holding Domain model (1), Interaction design (2), Technical specification (1) and Test plan (1); Technical specification holding Standards (1), which links `DM-STD-CODE`.

title: A product's and a domain's one page, at its ID, shows its text, its facts, its links both ways and its problems
when: Opens a product and a domain at their IDs.
then: Expects, for Demo shop at `/DM` and Shopping at `/DM-SHOP`, its text, a Problems in this heading, the Data file fact and the Links out and Links in headings in the wiki card, and no link to a product or domain overview page.

title: The domain page groups records by stage and folder, with rules and requirements nested
when: Opens the Shopping domain page and unfolds its Basket aggregate and its Buying capability; then opens Notebook's domain page.
then: Expects the stages Domain model (Aggregates, Specifications, Read models, Terms), Use cases (its capabilities, with no folder heading), Interaction design (Flows, Endpoints), Technical specification (Tables, Command handlers) and Test plan (Invariant tests, Use case tests), each with its color and count; the Basket aggregate folding its entities, invariant, event and command, the read model its query, and Buying its use case; rows with what they name in code (`baskets`, `src/basket.ts`, `service · test/basket.test.ts`), a test not automated yet marked so, and no shared value object or view; and on Notebook's domain only Aggregates under Domain model, with `Nothing yet.` in Use cases.

title: The search box filters records by ID or title as you type
when: Types a title fragment and an ID fragment into the search box.
then: Expects `add item` to keep the Basket aggregate with its matching command opened under it (`DM-SHOP-A1`, `DM-SHOP-CMD01`) and `Nothing matches.` in Specifications and Command handlers; `cmd01-h` to keep only `DM-SHOP-CMD01-H`, with `Nothing matches.` in Use case tests; and clearing it to bring every record back.

title: The domain page lists its coverage gaps and its problems
when: Opens the Shopping domain page, reads its Coverage and Problems sections, and expands every aggregate.
then: Checks the coverage gaps, each with the link that is missing, the "not proved" tag on the record's row, and the domain's problems, errors first and no other domain's.

title: A group page opens the folder of its kind, and its breadcrumb names its stage as the nav does
when: Opens Shopping's Endpoints group page under Interaction design.
then: Expects the nav to open Endpoints of Shopping listing `POST /basket/items`, and the header strip's breadcrumb (shown, or behind its …) to name Interaction design.

title: Folder names and order come from the schema sections, in the nav and on the domain page alike
when: Opens Shopping's domain page with the Test plan stage renamed Tests and checks and put first in the schema.
then: Expects the domain page's stage headings to read Tests and checks, Domain model, Use cases, Interaction design and Technical specification, in that order.

title: The domain page heads its use cases with Capabilities, then the use cases outside any
when: Opens Shopping's domain page with a second use case, `DM-SHOP-UC02`, under the Buying capability.
then: Expects the domain page's Use cases stage to list the capability `DM-SHOP-CAP01` with `DM-SHOP-UC02` folded under it, not listed on its own.

title: A domain's Technical specification lists its records by technical kind in the plan's order, each with what it names in code
when: Opens a domain page and reads its Technical specification's kind headings and rows.
then: Expects the kind headings in the plan's order, a repository's row with its file and a table's with its name.

title: A domain's Test plan lists its tests by test kind in the plan's order, each with its run by
when: Opens a domain page and reads its Test plan's kind headings, then opens Shopping's domain page and reads its test rows.
then: Expects the test kind headings in the plan's order, and each test's level, file when automated, and state.

title: The domain page heads Technical specification and Test plan with the nav's kind folders, in its order
when: Unfolds Technical specification and Test plan of Shopping in the nav, then opens Shopping's domain page and reads the kind headings of both stages.
then: Expects the domain page's kind headings of both stages to be the nav's kind folders, with their counts, in the same order.

title: A stage's group page of tests reads them in the same kind groups
when: Opens Shopping's Test plan group page.
then: Expects the Test plan group page to head its tests by Invariant tests and Use case tests, with their counts.

title: An endpoint sits in its domain's Interaction design and an integration in the one domain that uses it, by their stage
when: Builds a domain's folders and the graph's tree.
then: Expects Interaction design to hold the flow, the view, the endpoints and the integration, and the graph to place the endpoint and the integration in that stage's kind folders.

title: Coverage shows one group per obligation kind with designed, built, proved and not automated
when: Opens the Demo shop product page and Shopping's domain page over a workspace whose Shopping has invariants, UC requirements and a product's own Security controls kind, then the product page over a workspace with tests in each state.
then: Expects Shopping's card to show three labeled groups, Invariants, UC requirements and Security controls, each with designed, built, proved and not automated counts; a not automated bar drawn apart from proof, never full and titled as not proof; a kind with no obligations in a domain drawing no bars; and the domain page's Coverage with the same three groups and the gap `DM-SHOP-EP01-SC01` Security control not designed.

title: Coverage shows the pattern rule line
when: Opens Shopping's domain page in a workspace where two domains follow the audit pattern, and reads its Coverage section.
then: Expects the domain's coverage to show the pattern rule line with its counts, and gaps naming the rule.

title: The domain page lists interaction requirements under their view, endpoint or flow
when: Opens Shopping's domain page with an endpoint that has an API requirement and a record of a product's own obligation kind, unfolds the endpoint, then folds it and filters the records for "answers 201".
then: Expects the endpoint `DM-SHOP-EP01` POST /basket/items in Interaction design's Endpoints (count 1) with 2 children folded; unfolded, its API requirement `DM-SHOP-EP01-R01` and the product's own `DM-SHOP-EP01-SC01`, whose row shows not designed, and no Other records section; and a filter for "answers 201" keeping the endpoint above `DM-SHOP-EP01-R01`, with Flows reading "Nothing matches."

title: The domain page tags each test with its state, and one not automated yet looks unfinished
when: Opens Shopping's domain page and reads the state tag on each test row of its Test plan.
then: Expects the Test plan rows `DM-SHOP-INV01-T` not automated yet, `DM-SHOP-UC01-R01-T01` automated and `DM-SHOP-UC01-R02-T01` manual, with only the first row and its tag marked not-automated and titled as not counting as proof.

title: A domain follows the patterns its use cases follow
when: Indexes workspaces whose domains and use cases follow the audit pattern, and reads which patterns a domain follows, which domains follow the pattern, its settings and each follower's setting values.
then: Checks which patterns a domain follows, which domains follow a pattern, a pattern's settings, and each follower's setting values.

title: A rule is designed, built and proved per domain
when: Judges the audit pattern's rule `DM-PAT-AUDIT-R01` in Shopping and in Payments.
then: Expects `DM-PAT-AUDIT-R01` to apply in Shopping, proved by `DM-PAT-AUDIT-R01-T01`, and in Payments to apply with no proof, only `DM-PAT-AUDIT-R01-T02` not automated yet.

title: The domain page lists the patterns it follows
when: Opens Payments' domain page and unfolds the audit pattern under Patterns we follow.
then: Expects Patterns we follow (1) to list `DM-PAT-AUDIT` followed by `DM-PAY-UC01` with its 3 rules folded; unfolded, `DM-PAT-AUDIT-R01` reads not proved and not automated yet, titled with `DM-PAT-AUDIT-R01-T02`, and `DM-PAT-AUDIT-R02` names setting retention.

title: A domain that follows no pattern says so
when: Opens the Notes domain page, whose domain and use cases follow no pattern.
then: Expects Patterns we follow to read "This domain follows no pattern."

title: A pattern the domain itself follows is listed, followed by the whole domain, and every rule applies
when: Makes a domain follow a pattern directly.
then: Expects the pattern among the domain's followed patterns with no use cases, a rule with a setting still applying, and its row on the domain page reading "followed by the whole domain".

title: A rule whose test's file does not exist is not proved, as coverage says
when: Loads a product through the engine whose pattern rule test is automated and names a file that does not exist, then adds that file.
then: Expects coverage to list no proof for the rule and the domain page's pattern list to say not proved, matching coverage's 0 proved; once the file exists and names the test, both say proved.

title: Which rules a domain owes is the engine's answer
when: Loads workspaces through the engine where a domain follows a pattern through a use case and where a domain follows it itself.
then: Expects, for every following domain and rule, the page's status, the Traceability owing domains and the domain page's mark to match the owed rules coverage gives.

title: Pages only read until the person acts: the record actions are the only controls that lead to a write, and opening a page or searching it sends none
when: Opens every spec page, types in its search boxes, and looks for forms, inputs and buttons before any record action is chosen.
then: Expects no form, editor or input but the search boxes and the stage's own view controls (the Changes baseline picker among them), every button a plain button, the only buttons that lead to a command inside the record's Change toolbar, and no request but GET reads and no command sent.

title: A list of children or members of one kind is titled by that kind
when: Opens an invariant, a use case, the Shopping domain page with its capability unfolded, a command, Shopping's Flows group page, and the invariant again with the invariant test kind relabeled Proof.
then: Expects invariant `DM-SHOP-INV01` to title its tests Invariant tests (1) in a list named "Invariant tests of DM-SHOP-INV01", with no Children heading and no list in its facts; the unfolded capability's list named "Use cases of DM-SHOP-CAP01"; command `DM-SHOP-CMD01`'s mixed children to stay Children (2), tagged Command handler and Endpoint; the Flows group page to title its members Flows in a list named "Flows of DM-SHOP/interaction-design/flow", with no Members heading; and the relabeled kind to title the list Proofs.

title: An aggregate's domain events are listed apart, titled "Domain events", and left out of its Entities
when: Opens the Loan aggregate `P-D-A3`'s page on the Graph stage.
then: Expects a Domain events section holding a list named "Domain events of P-D-A3".

title: plural() makes a kind label plural as English does, and counts with the singular for one
when: Pluralizes kind labels, and counts one and four of a kind.
then: Expects "UC requirements", "Policies" and the like, "1 domain" and "4 domains".

title: Requirements, pattern rules and standard rules read under their group headings, the ungrouped first
when: Opens a use case with one ungrouped requirement and three in two groups (one written in another case).
then: Expects the Children section and the requirement table to show the ungrouped one first and each group under its heading, a pattern page to group its rules the same way, and a standard's rule table to head its group's rows.

title: The record page shows a test's state, and says one not automated yet is not proof
when: Opens a not automated yet, a manual and an automated test on the Graph stage.
then: Expects the State fact to read not automated yet, manual and automated, the raw `state` field not repeated, a note "Not automated yet. No file runs it, so it does not count as proof" on the first only, and Run by giving the manual test's reason and the automated test's file `test/basket.test.ts`.

title: An obligation lists Designed by, Built by and Proved by as its chain holds them, each build record marked built or not
when: Opens a UC requirement's and an invariant's content.
then: Expects their Traceability groups in order (Designed by, Built by, Proved by) holding the engine's chain, only the build records marked built or not built, kind tags only in the list that mixes kinds, and no gap callout for a requirement that is designed, built and proved.

title: Gap callouts agree with coverage, link to their check, and a pattern rule has one line per domain
when: Shows the Traceability of a requirement neither built nor proved, a requirement neither designed nor proved, an invariant whose only test is not automated yet, and two pattern rules, and judges every coverage gap of every domain.
then: Expects gaps not-built and not-proved on `DM-SHOP-UC01-R02` and not-designed and not-proved on `DM-PAY-UC01-R01`, each linking its check's page; "Not proved yet: its test is not automated yet." on `DM-SHOP-INV01`; `DM-PAT-AUDIT-R01` owed only by Shopping, needing no design and reading designed, built and proved, `DM-PAT-AUDIT-R03` owed by Shopping, as every rule of a pattern it follows, and `DM-PAT-AUDIT-R02` not proved yet; and every coverage gap matched by a gap of its kind.

title: An obligation's Traceability shows what designs it and what proves it, and names a gap in a callout
when: Opens UC requirement `DM-SHOP-UC01-R01`, then the product's own obligation `DM-SHOP-EP01-SC01`.
then: Expects the requirement's Designed by `DM-SHOP-CMD01`, `DM-SHOP-UC01-FL01`, `DM-SHOP-UC01-FL01-S01` and `DM-V01`, Built by `DM-SHOP-CMD01-H` and Proved by `DM-SHOP-UC01-R01-T01`; and the obligation's gaps not-designed and not-proved.

title: A component shows Satisfies and Proved through; a test shows Proves and its file with its state
when: Shows the Traceability of an automated test whose file is missing, then of a manual flow test.
then: Expects the automated test `DM-SHOP-UC01-R01-T01` to show Proves `DM-SHOP-UC01-R01` and Run by with level service, state automated and file `test/basket.test.ts` marked file missing and linked to the test-file-missing check; and the manual flow test `P-D-UC01-FL01-T` to show Proves `P-D-UC01-FL01` and Run by with level browser, Manual because Run at the desk before each release., and no file.

title: In the desktop app a record page offers its file actions and a native menu, and in a browser none
when: Opens a record in a browser, then in the desktop app.
then: Expects no record actions in a browser; in the desktop app, Reveal in Finder, Open in editor and Copy ID for the record's data file; a right-click on the page title or a record link asking for the native menu, and elsewhere the page's own; and records found under nodes, links and titles.

title: A test shows its size and markers under Run by, and where it starts from
when: Opens a test that starts from a data set with a size and a marker.
then: Expects its Size volume, Markers smoke and Starts from, a plain test being small with none, and a data set with no run by.

title: A test shows the outcomes it measures
when: Opens a test that measures an outcome.
then: Expects Measures with the outcome in the test's Traceability.

title: Every one of Lathe's kinds has its aggregate's page, and a declared kind the Extension record page
when: Looks up each kind of the meta model in the Record page's list of pages.
then: Expects a page for every one of Lathe's kinds and the Extension record page for a kind a product declares.

title: A record's facts name the outcomes it serves, each a link, or say none reaches it
when: Opens an aggregate, its storage requirement and a view requirement of the demo shop whose capability serves an outcome, then an aggregate none reaches, then the outcome.
then: Expects each Serves line to link the outcome through get-serves, the unreached aggregate to say so and link serves-no-outcome, and the outcome to have no Serves line.

title: Under reduced motion focusing frames the new focus at once
when: Asks for reduced motion, clicks a requirement in its use case's graph.
then: Expects one camera move, straight to the framed view.

title: By touch, a node opens only on a second tap or a tap on its card
when: On a touch screen, taps a graph node on the canvas.
then: Expects the address unchanged, the node drawn as selected and its box in the keyboard layer outlined, and a card naming it; a tap on the canvas away from every box lets go; the card is one button named for opening the node, beside the let go button, and a tap on it opens the node. `isTap` reads a mouse as a click and a finger or a pen as a tap.

title: Stability: an open pane is not drawn anew, and a canvas that opens appears already fitted
when: Opens and closes the Graph and ERD panes (Ctrl+2, Ctrl+4, Ctrl+1), full screen (Ctrl+3, Escape).
then: Expects the nav to stay, open panes not to be drawn anew, and a canvas to appear already fitted.

title: A domain event is a flag in its stage's colors
when: Reads the domain event kind's shape and stage.
then: Expects the event's shape a flag in the Domain model stage.

title: A domain's hexagon points grow with its box up to a cap, and tree lines meet their tips
when: Measures the hexagon's chamfer at several box sizes and the parent lines into and out of a domain, then opens a product's graph.
then: Checks the chamfer's growth and cap, a line out of a domain starting at the point's tip at its middle and on its slanted side above it, a line into a domain meeting the tip; and on a product's graph every domain node, and only domains, carrying the hexagon's class and its polygon outline, and the product its rounded box.

title: Stability: a domain is drawn as a hexagon, its outline the polygon in every state
when: Opens the product's graph.
then: Expects the domain drawn as its hexagon, its outline a six-cornered polygon; hovered, the same polygon in the hover state; focused, still the polygon, drawn as the focus; and the product drawn as a rounded box, not a polygon.

title: Every kind is drawn in its own shape, a group as a folder and an added kind as a plain box
when: Reads every kind's shape and mark, a group's and an unknown kind's, renders the graph key, and lays a label and badge into each shape at several box sizes and text scales.
then: Expects every kind of the meta-model to have the shape and mark of the rule's table, a group a folder and an unknown kind a plain box, every shape and mark used and named in the key; on a leaf and on boxes grown with their level, a label as tall and wide as its padding and room allow, and its badge at the top right, inside every shape's outline; and each shape's outline, notch and room as the page draws them.

title: Stability: in the Tree view every label line and badge lands inside its own box's shape
when: Opens a domain's graph in the Tree view at each depth, and for every drawn box big enough to read hit-tests, with the canvas's own hit test, the corners of each label line (at its drawn width) and each badge, expecting each to land on its own box, inside its polygon or rounded outline; then in the Nested view.
then: Expects every record box to be drawn with its kind's shape mark and no outline of its own.

title: The pointer finds the deepest box under it from the map's outlines
when: Hit-tests points against a triangle, a rounded box, the middle of every box's label in each layout, a point far outside the map, and a domain hexagon's cut corner.
then: Expects a point inside a polygon found and one outside not; a rounded box's corner outside its curve not its box; in each layout the middle of every box's label to find that box, not its parent drawn under it; nothing far outside the map; and a hexagon's cut corner outside the domain.

title: Only boxes, bars and lines on the canvas are drawn, placed relative to the camera's center
when: Asks whether boxes on, past and near each edge of a camera's pane are on screen, at zoom 1, zoomed out four times, and deep in a very large map at a very deep zoom.
then: Expects a box on screen drawn, one just past an edge kept for the margin its edge reaches, and one wholly past it culled; a line across the pane drawn and one below it culled; a far box coming into view when the camera zooms out about the same center, and a tiny box deep in a very large map, at a very deep zoom, placed as exactly as one near the origin.

title: Stability: the camera moves at every focus, Back and Forward
when: Focuses a domain, a stage, a folder, a capability and a use case by clicking, then goes Back twice and Forward once.
then: Expects the camera different at each step.

title: Stability: zooming the camera draws a label at its map size times the zoom
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph, focuses its Design stage and zooms in.
then: Expects the title's font size in map units and its lines unchanged, and its size on screen to change by the camera's zoom alone.

title: With Scroll to zoom off, scroll pans the camera, Shift+scroll sideways, and Cmd/Ctrl+scroll or a pinch zooms
when: Reads wheel events with Scroll to zoom off: plain deltaY and deltaX, Shift with deltaY and with an already-swapped deltaX, line and page deltas, and deltaY with Cmd, with a pinch, with Ctrl, and large.
then: Expects a pan by the same pixels down and across, Shift to turn deltaY sideways once only, line deltas scaled by 20 px and page deltas by the pane's size, and Cmd or Ctrl to zoom in on scrolling up, a pinch at today's speed, one event by a doubling at most.

title: A key that changes a scroll's move mid-scroll drops the rest of that scroll, until a new scroll
when: Feeds a zoom stream that lets Cmd go mid-stream with fading momentum, then presses it again, then pauses; a pan stream that presses Ctrl mid-stream; a zoom stream whose dropped momentum is followed, with no pause, by growing deltas; and, with Scroll to zoom on, a zoom stream that presses Cmd, a Ctrl pan stream that lets it go, and a zoom stream that presses Shift.
then: Expects the events after the change dropped while momentum fades, whatever the keys do; the next scroll after a pause to move; growing deltas to move again at once, with the move they start with; and with Scroll to zoom on, Cmd, letting go of Ctrl and Shift each to drop the rest of the scroll they change.

title: Focusing a parent with many children frames their column at reading size, the focus kept at the left edge
when: Frames a parent with eight children in a 6:1 Tree map at depths 1 to 3, and parents with two children and one.
then: Expects the eight children read, whole rows of them in view, and the focus at the left edge; the parents whose children read keep their own frame.

title: With Scroll to zoom on, scroll zooms about the pointer, Cmd/Ctrl+scroll pans, Shift+scroll pans sideways, and a pinch zooms
when: Reads wheel events with Scroll to zoom on: plain deltaY up and down, in lines and a page; deltaX and deltaY with Cmd, deltaY with Ctrl, in lines and pages; Shift with deltaY and with an already-swapped deltaX; and a pinch, small and large.
