then: Expects plain scroll to zoom in on scrolling up at Cmd's speed, a line scaled and a page a doubling at most; Cmd or Ctrl to pan by the same pixels down and across, a line by 20 px and a page by the pane's size; Shift to pan sideways once only; and a pinch to zoom at today's speed, a doubling at most.

title: Stability: the wheel pans the Graph and the ERD, and with Scroll to zoom on zooms them
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph, scrolls over the stage, turns Scroll to zoom on in Appearance and scrolls again, then scrolls with Cmd held, and does the same on the ERD.
then: Expects a scroll to pan the camera with its zoom unchanged while Scroll to zoom is off, and to zoom it in with Scroll to zoom on, where Cmd with scroll pans, on both stages.

title: Depth counts levels of the tree below the focus, stages and folders included, with the parent kept
when: Frames a requirement at depths 1 to 3 (the same picture: it has nothing below it), the Use cases stage at each depth (its capabilities, their use cases, their requirements), the Domain model stage at depth 1 (its folders), and an aggregate.
then: Expects the parent kept, each node's distance and the node it was reached from, only parent lines, and no sibling or link.

title: Clicking a neighbor frames it, and the address, the header strip and the wiki card follow
when: Renders a flow step's page on the Graph stage in jsdom and clicks its flow.
then: Expects the address `/P-D-UC01-FL01?stage=graph`, the header strip's title and the graph's center on it, its steps drawn and no visited trail; then goes back and expects the flow step again.

title: At depth 1 the graph frames the tree around the focus: its parent or folder at the left edge, its children or their folders, and no other links
when: Frames a capability in its stage, a domain, an aggregate with two kinds of children and a requirement at depth 1.
then: Expects the parent, the children or their groups, no siblings, and only parent lines.

title: The graph opens at depth 1, framing the parent and the children, and depth 2 and 3 frame more levels below; only parent lines are drawn
when: Opens the Use cases stage's graph.
then: Expects the depth buttons 1 to 3 with 1 pressed and no links, then depth 2 framing more records with a new summary; then a flow step's graph drawing only parent lines, and no Links button.

title: Depth counts levels below a domain and a use case, as a file explorer does
when: Frames a domain at depths 1 to 3.
then: Expects its stages, then their folders, then what is in them, one level more each time; and a use case in a capability, its capability the only node above it at every depth.

title: Stability: at depth 2 on a domain, the domain, its stages and their folders are framed in the canvas, each showing its full title wrapped on whole words
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph at depth 2.
then: Expects, in the drawn scene, the domain, every stage and at least half the folders wholly in the canvas, and every framed box (the domain, its product at the left edge, its stages and their folders) labeled with its whole title, each of its lines fitting as drawn and every line but the last ending after a space or a hyphen.

title: Clicking a node re-centers the graph and changes the address, Back walks back, and no visited trail is drawn
when: Renders a flow step's page on the Graph stage in jsdom and clicks its flow.
then: Expects the address `/P-D-UC01-FL01?stage=graph`, the header strip's title Lend a thing in the web app and the graph's center on the flow, its use case `P-D-UC01` drawn and no Records visited trail; then Back returns to the flow step.

title: Nodes and lines show stage, errors and gaps, with a key
when: Opens the graph on a flow step, a capability, an aggregate, the use case tests' folder, an aggregate's invariants and the product.
then: Expects each node drawn in its stage's colors, an error badge on a test with an error, a gap badge on a rule with a gap, the parent lines, and the key.

title: On a product's graph only domain nodes carry the hexagon's class, and the product a rounded box
when: Measures the hexagon's chamfer at several box sizes and the parent lines into and out of a domain, then opens a product's graph.
then: Checks the chamfer's growth and cap, a line out of a domain starting at the point's tip at its middle and on its slanted side above it, a line into a domain meeting the tip; and on a product's graph every domain node, and only domains, carrying the hexagon's class and its polygon outline, and the product its rounded box.

title: Stability: a domain keeps its hexagon when hovered and focused, and the product is a rounded box
when: Opens the product's graph.
then: Expects the domain drawn as its hexagon, its outline a six-cornered polygon; hovered, the same polygon in the hover state; focused, still the polygon, drawn as the focus; and the product drawn as a rounded box, not a polygon.

title: Each shape keeps its label and badge inside its outline, and the key names every shape and mark
when: Reads every kind's shape and mark, a group's and an unknown kind's, renders the graph key, and lays a label and badge into each shape at several box sizes and text scales.
then: Expects every kind of the meta-model to have the shape and mark of the rule's table, a group a folder and an unknown kind a plain box, every shape and mark used and named in the key; on a leaf and on boxes grown with their level, a label as tall and wide as its padding and room allow, and its badge at the top right, inside every shape's outline; and each shape's outline, notch and room as the page draws them.

title: Stability: in the Nested view every record box shows its kind's shape mark and no outline
when: Opens a domain's graph in the Tree view at each depth, and for every drawn box big enough to read hit-tests, with the canvas's own hit test, the corners of each label line (at its drawn width) and each badge, expecting each to land on its own box, inside its polygon or rounded outline; then in the Nested view.
then: Expects, on the domain, its Domain model and its Use cases at depths 1 to 3 in the Tree view, every label line and badge corner of each readable box to hit its own box; and in the Nested view more than five boxes, each with its shape's mark and no outline of its own.

title: Every box look, badge and line style the Graph stage can draw is in its key, with what it means
when: Lists the Graph stage's key entries for every look, shape, mark and badge it can draw, in each layout, with the live marks, and reads them in a key bar.
then: Expects the key, across the Tree and Nested layouts and the live marks, to give words for every box look, the focus, every shape, a Nested box, a bar, every badge tone, the parent line and every live mark.

title: Filters hide kinds and paths through them, never the focus
when: Hides use cases, entities, aggregates and the focus's own kind.
then: Expects the hidden records to go, nothing to be reached through them, a folder gone with its kind while a stage stays, and the focus to stay even when its own kind is hidden.

title: The arrow keys step through the tree from a focused box, Enter re-centers on the box with keyboard focus, and Escape clears the filters
when: Focuses the center box and presses Left, Right and Down; presses Up on the canvas, and Left with Alt held; focuses another box and presses Enter; hides a kind and presses Escape.
then: Expects each arrow to move the focus with keyboard focus following from a box and staying on the canvas, Alt+Left to do nothing, Enter to re-center on the focused box, and Escape to show the hidden kind again.

title: Stability: in every layout Tab, Enter and the Left arrow work the graph with a visible focus ring
when: Runs one table of the graph's features in each layout.
then: The Layout switch and its `v` command, a click to focus, Enter on a focused box, Tab through the drawn boxes with a visible focus ring, the plain Left arrow stepping out to the parent once the graph has focus, `.` framing the focus, depth 1 to 3, a hidden kind keeping its space, the minimap, the trail, Back and Forward, and the hover spotlight; in the Nested view, every drawn child inside its parent's box on screen and the view kept for the session across a reload.

title: Columns follow the parent/child tree
when: Builds the graph neighborhood of a domain's Use cases stage four levels deep and of the domain two levels deep.
then: Expects `P-D`, the Use cases stage, `P-D-CAP01`, `P-D-UC01` and `P-D-UC01-R01` in columns 0 to 4, every parent line running from one column to the next, and from the domain the stages in one column with every folder, or a one-folder stage's record such as `P-D-CAP01`, in the next.

title: The graph reads left to right by column
when: Lays out a product's graph map.
then: Expects one x and one width per level of the map, levels left to right a gap apart, and ancestors to the left of a record.

title: Links never change the map or the framed picture: every box where it was without them
when: Adds two sibling entities that link to each other.
then: Expects every box of the map where it was without the links, and the picture framed around one of them unchanged, with only parent lines.

title: The page draws the map in columns with a solid parent/child spine, and draws no link between siblings
when: Opens a flow step's graph, then an aggregate's entities.
then: Expects the flow left of its step and a solid spine; then the three sibling entities that link to each other in one column, with no link drawn between them.

title: Siblings of mixed kinds share a column
when: Builds the neighborhood of a domain's Domain model stage two levels deep, and lays out the product's map.
then: Expects the Domain model's aggregates, specification, read model, domain service and term in one column and every node with the same parent in one column; and in the map the records straight in a domain's folders (`P-D-A1`, `P-D-UC01-FL01`, `P-D-EN02-TB`, `P-D-INV01-T`) at one level, `P-D-CAP01` at the folders' level, and the four aggregates at one x.

title: Ancestors sit to the left of the focus and descendants to its right
when: Builds a use case's neighborhood three levels deep and lays out the product's map.
then: Expects the capability `P-D-CAP01`, the use case `P-D-UC01` and its requirement `P-D-UC01-R01` in columns 0, 1 and 2 of the neighborhood, and on the map the product, the domain, its Use cases stage, the capability, the use case and the requirement each further right than the one before.

title: Focusing a child glides the camera on the shared motion, and no box moves or changes size
when: Opens a domain's graph, framed at once, clicks its use cases stage.
then: Expects the camera to glide there over several frames and end framing it, every box drawn before and after at the same place and size, and Back gliding back.

title: Focusing under reduced motion moves the camera once, never the map
when: Asks for reduced motion, clicks a requirement in its use case's graph.
then: Expects one camera move, straight to the framed view.

title: Stability: focusing anything moves the camera only, and no box changes its place or size
when: Opens the LA product's graph and focuses the LA-EXP domain, its Use cases stage, a capability and a use case by clicking each box, then goes Back twice and Forward once.
then: Expects each focus to move nothing outside the graph's boxes, eight cameras each unlike the one before and at least five distinct, and every one of more than 50 boxes seen to keep the same place and size throughout.

title: New data morphs what it moved and leaves the camera, unless the focus moved
when: Lays out a map, then a new layout with a child added, one arriving mid-glide, one under reduced motion and one of another product, and works out the camera for a focus that stayed and one that moved.
then: Expects only the moved boxes to glide from where they were drawn, nothing to glide under reduced motion or to another map, a plate drawn at another box to keep its label in it, and the camera to stay or to keep the moved focus where it was on screen.

title: Hovering or focusing a box spotlights it, its lines and the boxes it joins, and leaving restores the picture
when: Opens a flow and focuses its first step.
then: Expects the step, the flow and the line between them lit, the flow's other step and its line dimmed, and blurring it to restore the picture.

title: Stability: in every layout hovering spotlights a node
when: In the Tree view and in the Nested view, moves the mouse over a labeled record box in view, the focus last if no other fits, then away.
then: Expects the graph to carry `has-spotlight` while the mouse is over the box.

title: In the Tree view the plain arrow keys step through the tree from the page, and buttons step too, naming their keys
when: Reads the step targets of a use case, a folder and the product, then shows the graph and presses the arrow keys on its canvas and on the page, with Alt held on the page, and clicks the step buttons.
then: Expects Right to step in to the first child, Left out to the parent and Up to the previous sibling, from the canvas or from the page, each moving the graph's focus; an only child's Up and Down to go on to a node at the same depth under another parent; two clicks of Step out to the parent to go to `P-D-CAP01` and then `P-D/use-cases`; the step buttons' aria-keyshortcuts `ArrowLeft A`, `ArrowDown S`, `Shift+ArrowUp Shift+W` and `Shift+ArrowDown Shift+S`; and Alt+Down to step nowhere.

title: Each arrow takes its view's step: in Tree, Left out, Right in, Up and Down across; in Nested, Up out, Down in, Left and Right across; across goes on past the first sibling
when: With a stage in the Graph stage that has a parent, a first child and a sibling either side, drawn in the Tree and Nested views in turn, reads the step buttons in each view, presses each of the four arrows on the canvas and goes Back after each, steps previous from the first stage twice and then next, then opens the shortcuts sheet.
then: Expects each arrow to step where the view's mapping says, previous from the first sibling to go on to the previous parent's last child at that level and next to come back, the step buttons Left, Right, Up, Down, Out and In in the same order in every view, each named by the step its arrow takes in that view and showing its arrow and letter, with its keys in aria-keyshortcuts, and the sheet's rows listing each move's arrow and letter, Out and In with Shift.

title: Filters have a Minimap switch, off by default and kept while walking, and the minimap is an overview of the whole map
when: Opens Filters.
then: Expects a Minimap switch, off, no context ring switch, and no relation filters or preset; switches the minimap on and expects an overview of the map's upper levels, the focus solid and the view outlined, still there after walking on.

title: Stability: the Layout switch and v move between Tree and Nested, kept across a reload
when: Opens a record's graph in Tree, then presses `v` on the graph for Nested; in each reads the Layout switch, and in Nested reloads the page.
then: Expects the pressed Layout button to name the view and the graph's `data-layout` to match it, and after the reload the Nested button still pressed.

title: Depth shows only in the Tree layout
when: Opens a stage in the Tree layout.
then: Expects the Depth buttons shown. Switches to Nested and expects the Depth group to keep its slot but be hidden, aria-hidden and inert, so it is neither seen nor reached. Switches back to Tree and expects it again.

title: A record with several kinds of child has a labeled, counted group per kind
when: Reads a domain's child kinds, the labels and members of its groups with and without a second kind of child, and parses group IDs.
then: Expects the domain's child kinds in order; labels `Entities (3)`, `Commands (2)`, `Technical specification (9)`, `Tables (3)` and `Commands (1)`; no entity group for an aggregate with one kind of child until a command joins it; the Tables folder holding `P-D-EN02-TB`, `P-D-EN03-TB` and `P-D-RM01-TB`; and a group ID to parse to its parent, kind and path, to name no record, and to be a graph node only when the tree has it.

title: Every group is in the map with all its members beside it, and the spine runs record, group, record
when: Frames a domain at depths 1 and 2.
then: Expects its stages and folders as groups with their counts, the spine running through a group to its records, and every group in the map holding all its members right beside it and spanning them exactly.

title: A stage or folder is drawn as a folder group, and Enter on a stage goes to its address
when: Opens a domain's graph.
then: Expects the open questions' group drawn as a folder with no chevron and no button; clicks the group and expects its address, the group the center, and its name and count in its tooltip; goes back and presses Enter on a stage and expects its address.

title: Groups are drawn as folders, and the key has an entry for them
when: Renders a domain.
then: Expects the Test plan stage to carry an `!` error mark and the Domain model stage a `gap` mark, each in its own stage's color; the Test plan's aria-label `Stage Test plan (<count>) in P-D`; the open questions' group no mark; and a `Folder` entry in the key titled for a stage, folder or group.

title: The graph's tree is the nav's tree
when: Reads the graph tree's children, parents and labels from a domain, its stages, a capability, a use case, an aggregate, a command and the product.
then: Expects a domain's five stages then its open questions' group; each stage's folders in the nav's order and counts; Use cases holding its capability itself, with no folder; a capability's use case and a use case's requirements as their children, its flow under Interaction design's Flows folder and its flow test under the Test plan's; Interaction design's and Technical specification's folders in the schema's kind order; an aggregate's entity, invariant, domain event and command groups and a command's policy under it; the product's Shared folder before its domains; and every child's parent to be the node that lists it.

title: Filters hide groups with their kind
when: Builds neighborhoods with commands, questions, aggregates, capabilities or use cases filtered out, and builds one neighborhood twice.
then: Expects no group for a hidden kind, a stage kept when one of its kinds is hidden, and the same graph every time.

title: A group shows its name and count, with no chevron; clicking a group, or Enter on it, goes to it
when: Opens a domain's graph.
then: Expects the open questions' group drawn as a folder with no chevron and no button; clicks the group and expects its address, the group the center, and its name and count in its tooltip; goes back and presses Enter on a stage and expects its address.

title: A group can be the focus: its parent and all its members are shown, and depth counts levels from it
when: Builds the neighborhood of a domain's Aggregates folder at depths 1, 2 and 3, and of groups the tree does not have, and reads group addresses.
then: Expects the folder at distance 0 with its Domain model stage and its four aggregates, the spine from the stage through the folder to each aggregate, the aggregates' groups at depth 2 and their members such as `P-D-EN03` and `P-D-CMD06` only at depth 3, nothing for a group the tree does not have, and the addresses `/P-D/domain-model/aggregate`, `/P-D/domain-model` and `/P-D-UC01`.

title: A group has its own address with its parent left and its members right, and Back works
when: Opens a domain on the Graph stage, clicks its Domain model stage's box, then its Aggregates folder, goes Back, then opens `/P-D/use-cases/capability` and `/P-D/flow`.
then: Expects the stage's address with `?stage=graph` and the title `Domain model (<count>)`, the stage the focus with the domain to its left and its Aggregates folder to its right, the breadcrumb linking `Domain (P-D)`, the folder's address, Back returning to the stage, and both other addresses to say there's no record or group.

title: A stage or folder group page names the group by its own name, not by a kind
when: Opens the DM-SHOP domain's Domain model stage page on the Graph stage.
then: Expects the heading to start `Domain model`, the intro to read `Domain model of DM-SHOP`, and the page never to say `Domain models`.

title: A group carries a summary mark for problems and gaps beneath it
when: Reads the summary marks of the aggregates' folder, the use case tests' folder and an aggregate's commands group, and the colors of a test group and a question group.
then: Expects the Aggregates folder to carry 1 warning and the `proved` and `record-untraced` gaps, the use case tests' folder 1 error, an aggregate's commands group no mark, a test group outlined in the Test plan's edge color and the open questions' group in muted gray, both on the sheet fill.

title: A group carries error and gap marks when trouble lies beneath it, and none when clean
when: Renders a domain.
then: Expects the Test plan stage to carry an `!` error mark and the Domain model stage a `gap` mark, each in its own stage's color; the Test plan's aria-label `Stage Test plan (<count>) in P-D`; the open questions' group no mark; and a `Folder` entry in the key titled for a stage, folder or group.

title: Groups take their own column between the parent and its children
when: Lays out a group's neighborhood.
then: Expects the parent, the group, its members, a member's own group and its members from left to right, a member's group beside another member's ungrouped child, and every group one column after its parent and one before its members.

title: A group sits in its own column between its parent and its members
when: Lays out the map of a product whose aggregate has both entities and commands.
then: Expects the Domain model stage, its Aggregates folder, the aggregate `P-D-A4`, its Entities group and the entity `P-D-EN06` each one level further right, and the Entities group on the same level as the read model's ungrouped query `P-D-QRY01`.

title: An aggregate's events sit under it in a Domain events group, and the graph draws no raises or hears link
when: Reads an aggregate's tree children, its Domain events group's label, an event's parent, and the event's neighborhood.
then: Expects the aggregate's Domain events group with its count, the event under it, and only parent lines in the event's picture.

title: A parent spans its children stacked, an equal part each, from its top edge to its bottom edge, each child beside it, nothing overlapping
when: Builds the maps of three workspaces, two synthetic trees and a product with a busy part and a quiet one.
then: Expects every root the product box's height, every parent's children of one height, stacked from its top to its bottom a tenth of each one's part apart, each in the next level right of it, no two boxes in a level overlapping, the busy part and the quiet one the same height with the busy one's children smaller, and the tree the nav's.

title: Tall parents carry their height and text scale, every box its text scale as its box scale, and every parent line is level
when: Opens a domain's graph at depth 2.
then: Expects, in the drawn scene, the domain taller than its stages stacked with a text scale above 1, every drawn box's box scale its text scale, and every parent line drawn level.

title: Stability: at depth 2 on a domain, every framed box shows its full title wrapped on whole words
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph at depth 2.
then: Expects every framed box (the domain, its product at the left edge, its stages and their folders) labeled with its whole title, each of its lines fitting as drawn and every line but the last ending after a space or a hyphen.

title: Stability: no label is clipped, in light and dark, focused or not, at several zooms
when: In light and dark, opens the Exploring domain and then its Use cases stage on the Graph stage, sets depth 1, 2 and 3, then zooms in twice.
then: Expects every drawn box in the canvas to fit each of its lines, read from the drawn scene: each line's width as the canvas measures it at its drawn font at most its placed width, and the line inside its box, with half a map unit and half a pixel to spare.

title: Stability: a label keeps its size in the map when the focus changes
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph, reads its Interaction design stage's title font size, lines and on-screen height in the drawn scene, focuses the stage, then zooms in.
then: Expects the font size in map units and the lines unchanged, and the title's size on screen to change only with the camera's zoom.

title: Pattern rules sit under their pattern in the graph
when: Builds the audit pattern's neighborhood one level deep.
then: Expects parent lines from the pattern to its rules and each rule one column to the pattern's right.

title: A flow step sits one column right of its flow, joined by the parent line
when: Builds the graph neighborhood of a flow with three steps, two levels deep.
then: Expects a flow's three steps in its neighborhood, joined to it directly, all in the column after it.

title: A flow's steps hang under it directly, or through a group beside other kinds
when: Builds the graph neighborhood and the product map of a flow with six steps.
then: Expects the flow's spine to run straight to its first and sixth steps with no `flow_step` group, the flow under Interaction design's Flows folder and its test under the Test plan's Flow tests folder, and in the map the fifth step's parent to be the flow.

title: A domain reaches its technical records through Technical specification, then a folder per kind
when: Reads a domain's tree children, its Technical specification's folders, and the parents of a repository and a command handler.
then: Expects the domain's Technical specification stage, its kind folders, and a repository and a command handler under theirs.

title: A domain reaches its tests through Test plan, then a folder per test kind, as the nav does
when: Reads a domain's tree children, a flow test's parent, and the tests in each Test plan folder.
then: Expects the domain's Test plan stage, each of its folders holding tests of its own kind, and a flow test under Flow tests.

title: The graph draws a standard as stacked boxes with a ruler in the product's Technical specification
when: Builds the neighborhood of a standard one level deep, reads the standard's and its rule's shapes, and renders the graph key.
then: Expects the standard under its product's Technical specification folder with its rules under it, drawn in the Technical specification stage's colors as stacked boxes and its rules as octagons, each with a ruler mark, and the key's stage, shape and ruler entries naming them.

title: In each layout, the arrows, a click, Enter, a tab and Back keep the layout, depth and minimap, in tabs open or new
when: A tab on a flow drawn as it starts, and a tab on its first step where the person set depth 2, the minimap on and the layout (Tree or Nested). Steps out, in, next, previous, next and out, each by the arrow that takes that step in the layout (LA-V93-R19), onto records another tab holds and records no tab holds, clicks a box, presses Enter on one, activates a tab, opens one in a new tab and goes Back.
then: Expects the toolbar to show the layout, depth and minimap the person set after every move, and the tab moved in still active; then v changes the layout.

title: Stability: in each layout, the arrows and clicks keep the layout, depth and minimap, into tabs open or new
when: In Chromium, a tab on LA-EXP-UC03-FL01 drawn as it starts, and a tab on its first step where the person set depth 2, the minimap on and the layout (Tree or Nested). Steps out, in, next twice, previous twice and out, each by the arrow that takes that step in the layout (LA-V93-R19), onto steps another tab holds and steps no tab holds, and clicks the boxes of steps, stepping out by the layout's arrow after each.
then: Expects the graph's layout, the pressed layout and depth buttons and the minimap unchanged after every move.

title: The graph's settings last the session: the minimap comes back on reload
when: Turns the minimap on, then reloads the page.
then: Expects the minimap still on.

title: In each layout the focus and its subtree are drawn at full strength, its ancestors at their own, and every other box faded; the fade follows the focus
when: Opens a stage's graph in the Tree layout and a use case's in Nested, then clicks a faded box to focus it.
then: Expects the focus and every box under it at strength 1, its ancestors at the ancestors' strength in Nested and the fade's in Tree, every other box at the fade's, and after the click the new focus and its subtree at full strength and the old focus faded.

title: The map draws each domain as a region around its aggregates, and a reference to another domain's aggregate between regions
when: Builds the product's map, lays it out and opens the product on the ERD stage.
then: Expects one region per domain holding its aggregates, the reference to the other domain's aggregate running from region to region, each box inside its parent, and on the page each region labeled with its domain's name and nothing faded.

title: An aggregate's focus fades the aggregates it references, and its lines to them
when: Works out each box's strength for an aggregate's focus, then opens the aggregate.
then: Expects the aggregates it references faded, and on the page their boxes and the lines to them marked faded at the fade's strength.

title: A large region is laid out to about the map's shape, its layers wrapped or its parts packed, whichever comes nearer
when: Lays out a large domain's fifteen aggregates at their sizes with the references between them, wrapped and as the region pass does.
then: Expects the wrapped layout to stand taller than wide and the region to keep the nearer one, between 1.3 and 2.1 times as wide as tall.

title: The map draws each aggregate as a boundary around its entities with their fields, has one and has many lines with crow's feet, and a dashed reference from an entity to another aggregate's root
when: Builds the product's map and opens it.
then: Expects only domains, aggregates and entities, each aggregate a boundary around its entities with the root marked and each field's type, the has one and has many lines with their ends, one dashed reference line per entity and referenced aggregate ending at its root, each box laid out inside its parent; then on the page the boxes' names, the fields, no command, event or policy box, and the lines' tooltips.

title: An aggregate's focus keeps its boundary, entities, fields and lines at full strength, and fades the rest
when: Works out each box's strength and the scope's lines for an aggregate, then opens it.
then: Expects its boundary and entities at full strength, every other box, its domain's region among them, faded back, its scope's lines with their ends, lines from box edge to box edge and fanned apart; then on the page the root mark, the fields list, the aggregate picked out, another aggregate faded and a line to it faded.

title: An entity's focus keeps its aggregate at full strength, picks the entity out and frames it
when: Frames a child entity on the laid-out map, then opens it in the ERD stage.
then: Expects the camera to frame that entity's box, its aggregate at full strength, the entity alone picked out and named so, and the key naming the picked-out box.

title: Clicking a box goes to it, boxes show a hover state, and the key bar lists only the boxes and lines drawn
when: Opens a domain on the ERD stage.
then: Expects the stage's key bar, a floating panel at the bottom, to list `Domain`, `Aggregate`, `Entity`, `Root entity`, `Picked out`, `Faded`, `Has one (1:1)`, `Has many (1:n)` and `Reference by ID`, the reference dashed and has-many solid; a click on an aggregate's box to open its page with `?stage=erd`; Enter on an entity's box to open its page; and the hover ring, its speed and the domain model stage's tokens in the stylesheet.

title: Every box, badge and line an ERD draws is in the ERD stage's key, with what it means
when: Reads the key for a product, each domain, aggregate and entity on the model's map, and the ERD's styled marks.
then: Expects every mark drawn in the key with its meaning, and every styled mark one the test explains.

title: A domain's focus fades the other domains' regions, out of focus and out of the keyboard order, the fade easing on the shared motion
when: Works out each box's strength for a domain, reads the stylesheet, then opens the domain.
then: Expects only the other domain's region, aggregate and entity faded, the boxes' strength easing on the shared motion, and on the page the faded box hidden from assistive technology and out of the keyboard order while a box of the domain keeps its stop.

title: The frame fits what it frames inside the margin at any canvas size and inside the open space, never zoomed in past 1
when: Lays out the map and frames the whole map, an aggregate and an entity at three canvas sizes, then the whole map in an open space.
then: Expects every framed box inside the margin at a zoom of at most 1 at each size, and every box inside the open space a host's panels leave when framed in it.

title: A box whose center lies past an edge counts for that edge, and a chip pans half the canvas that way
when: Counts four box centers against a 1000 by 800 canvas, one seen through a zoomed and panned camera, and pans right and up.
then: Expects one past each edge, none for the box the moved camera brings inside, and each pan to move the camera half the canvas.

title: Any other record frames its nearest entity or aggregate in its domain, a Shared record and the product the whole map
when: Works out the ERD focus of a domain, an aggregate, an entity, a use case, a command, its handler, an event, a table, a group, a Shared value object and the product, frames each on the laid-out map, then opens a use case and an aggregate.
then: Expects a domain, aggregate or entity to pick out and frame its own box, any other record its nearest aggregate or entity (a table its entity) in its domain's scope, a Shared record and the product the whole map; the ERD button pressed and enabled on a use case, the domain's boxes in focus and the other domain's faded; and Ctrl+2 and Alt+G switching an aggregate between the ERD and Graph stages.

title: The map is laid out once: focusing two records moves no box and changes no size, and the layout is read again, never redone
when: Asks for the product's map and its layout twice, and for the layout of the same data loaded again, then opens a domain on the ERD stage and focuses an aggregate and then an entity by a click and by Enter.
then: Expects the same map and the same layout each time, a small map drawing every box, and every box's place and size on the page the same before and after each focus.

title: The product's ERD map is drawn and framed within its first-frame budget, and a focus after it lays nothing out
when: On the product's page, switches to the ERD stage, then clicks a domain's region.
then: Expects the map drawn and framed within the first-frame budget (ELK and the layout included), and the domain's focus, a camera move only, within the camera move budget.

title: Tidy up lays the map out afresh, and new data keeps every box where it was
when: Lays out the model product's ERD twice on the same data, then tidies up a changed map, and lays a product out again after its layout before.
then: Expects the same places for the same data, Tidy up giving a first layout's picture and becoming the layout read, and a later change keeping its places from it.

title: Record, domain and product pages open on the Graph stage with their graph, and the nav has no Graph item
when: Opens a requirement, a domain and a product with no stage remembered, switches to the Trace stage and back.
then: Expects the Graph stage pressed, no Graph item in the nav, the focus drawn, and after switching back the address `?stage=graph` with the focus drawn again.

title: Every page opens its graph in its own Graph stage, and the open nav has no Graph item
when: Opens Shopping's domain page, collapses and expands the nav, switches to the ERD stage and presses Ctrl+1, then searches the command palette for "graph stage".
then: Expects no Graph item in the open nav or the rail, the ERD button to set `?stage=erd`, Ctrl+1 to return to `?stage=graph`, and the palette's first option for "graph stage" to be `Graph stage`.

title: The graph takes its focus and reports moves through onNavigate and what it draws through onCounts, without touching the address
when: Renders the graph view on its own on a flow step away from its record's address, clicks a node, renders it on the node's focus, then resizes its container from 1000 to 300 px wide.
then: Expects the counts reported as `<n> records · … <n> links`, the click reported through onNavigate as `P-V01`, the address `/somewhere-else` unchanged throughout, and the camera to refit when the container changes size.

title: A record and a group each have one address, whatever the stage
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage and a group page at its own address.
then: Expects the Graph stage drawn with the address the bare ID, and the group page titled by its group.

title: An old address is no page: /records, /specs and /graph addresses say so, and the address stays as typed
when: Opens `/records/<id>`, `/records/<parent>/<kind>`, `/specs`, `/specs/<product>/<domain>`, `/graph`, `/graph/<id>`, `/format`, `/format/kinds/use_case` and `/settings/appearance`, then a record with the old `?view=trace`.
then: Expects each to read as a missing page, to say there is no such page, and to keep its address. Then opens a record with the old `?view=trace` and expects the Graph stage, as `view` names no stage.

title: The stage switch shows one stage at a time, named in the link and remembered, the Graph by default
when: Opens a use case with no stage, switches to the ERD, then opens another record.
then: Expects the Graph stage pressed and drawn with no pane, Split, Open beside or full screen; the ERD named as `?stage=erd`, pressed, the only stage drawn and remembered; the other record opening on the ERD; and the stage switch once, in the page bar.

title: Switching the stage by keyboard keeps focus, and the switch shows its keys and a focus ring
when: Focuses the graph's depth button on the Graph stage and presses Ctrl+2.
then: Expects the ERD stage drawn with focus on its pressed button, the Graph button's tooltip and `aria-keyshortcuts` naming Alt+G and Ctrl+1 off a Mac, and the shared focus ring and on look in the stylesheet.

title: Graph, ERD and Trace are pressed buttons of the stage switch, one pressed, its stage the one drawn
when: Opens a use case on the Trace stage.
then: Expects the Stage group's buttons Graph, ERD and Trace with Trace alone pressed, the Trace stage drawn and neither other stage.

title: The open space is measured from the panels' rectangles and written on the stage for its tools
when: Works out the open space a nav, a wiki card, a tab panel and a collapsed panel leave on a 1440 by 900 stage, and the frame a top toolbar leaves; then opens a use case on the Graph stage.
then: Expects the insets past each side's innermost panel plus the gap, nothing for a collapsed panel, the frame less the toolbar; on the page `--open-*` and `--frame-*` set on the stage with its tools at the top of the open space, in a room from the nav to the chat, centered on the whole stage while they fit and inside the room when wider, the tools' foot set on the stage's parent for the wiki card, and the Trace stage padding its content into the frame.

title: The graph frames its focus between the panels its host reports, and moves back when they go
when: Draws the graph 1200 by 800, then reports panels over the left 500 px, the right 300 px and the top 60 px, then none.
then: Expects the focus's box drawn inside the open space between them, and the camera to move again once the panels are gone.

title: The measure follows the stage the page makes anew when it changes between the phone and the wide layout
when: Opens a use case on the ERD stage, then narrows the screen to the phone layout and widens it again.
then: Expects the new stage to be another element, with `--open-left` set on it at once, so its tools sit inside the open space.

title: In the browser, at 1024 to 1920 px with the nav and the card open, the toolbar keeps its walk, Frame and the Graph's layouts and filters in its row, inside the open space
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage with the nav and the wiki card open, and sets the window 1024, 1280, 1440, 1600 and 1920 px wide.
then: Expects at each width the toolbar's row to fit, the toolbar inside the open space clear of the nav, the steps Left, Right, Up, Down, Out and In, Frame, the layouts and the filters in the row, never the phone's form, and the Changes controls in More whenever they are not in the row.

title: The stage, the header strip and the wiki card follow one focus, Back moves them all, and graph settings survive
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage at depth 2, follows a requirement's link in the wiki card, clicks its sibling on the stage, goes Back, and switches stage and back.
then: Expects the graph re-centered on the requirement, the card on the sibling after the click, the header strip and card back on the requirement after Back, and depth 2 kept across pages and stage switches.

title: A group page shows its parent, kind and members with their marks
when: Opens an aggregate's Invariants group page.
then: Expects the heading `Invariants (2)`, a link to the parent aggregate `P-D-A3`, the invariant kind's description, and the members `P-D-INV01` and `P-D-INV02`, the second alone marked `not proved` with `1 warning`.

title: Product and domain pages have the same three stages, their graph centered on the product or domain
when: Opens a product and a domain on the Graph stage.
then: Expects the overview's headings in the wiki card, the Stage group holding Graph, ERD and Trace, and the graph centered on the product or domain.

title: A product and a domain open at their IDs with their text in the wiki card
when: Opens a product and a domain at their IDs.
then: Expects each one's text, its Problems heading, its `Data file` fact and its Links out and Links in headings in the wiki card, and no link to a product or domain overview page.

title: The header strip names the focus in one line: its breadcrumb, kind, linked ID and title, whole in its tooltip, and the stage's counts
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage and reads the stylesheet.
then: Expects the page's h1 in the header strip with the breadcrumb, the kind badge and the ID linking to the use case, its whole title and ID as the tooltip, the graph's records and links as the counts, and the strip one fixed-height line whose title is cut with an ellipsis.

title: Opening in the same tab never switches tabs, even onto a page another tab holds
when: Moves the active tab of a set of two onto the page the other tab holds, then onto a page no tab holds.
then: Expects the same tab active after each move, its place on the page moved to, and the other tab's place unchanged.

title: Walking onto a record open in another tab stays in the current tab
when: The desktop app's bridge, with two tabs: the first on a use case, the second, active, on its flow. Walks by the arrows, clicks a box and follows a wiki card link onto the use case the first tab holds.
then: Expects the second tab still active and on the use case, the first tab unchanged, two tabs on the same record, and the address naming the second tab's place.

title: A move never leaves its tab, and a page may be open in several tabs, each its own
when: Moves the active tab of a set of two onto the page the other holds, then changes the stage of each.
then: Expects the same tab active after the move, both tabs on the page, and each tab's stage its own.

title: A new tab copies the stage, depth and filters, with a fresh history, after the active tab; in the background it leaves the active tab
when: Opens a new tab from the first of three tabs, whose place has moved twice and is on the ERD at depth 2 with a kind hidden; then opens one in the background.
then: Expects the new tab second, active, on the page opened, on the ERD at depth 2 with the kind hidden and one entry in its history; the background tab after the active one, which stays active.

title: Cmd or Ctrl+click and middle-click on a box or link, Cmd+Enter in quick open and the new tab command open a tab after the active one
when: The desktop app's bridge, on a use case. Cmd+clicks a box, middle-clicks a wiki card link, presses Cmd+Enter on a quick open result and runs the new tab command.
then: Expects each to open a tab after the active one: active for the Cmd+click, quick open and the command (on the product), in the background for the middle-click.

title: Duplicate tab copies the active tab with its history
when: The desktop app's bridge. Moves through three records in one tab, runs Duplicate tab and goes Back in the copy.
then: Expects a second tab after the first, active, on the same place, and Back stepping to the second record in it, the first tab unchanged.

title: The record's right-click menu offers Open in New Tab
when: Builds the native menu for a right-click on a record.
then: Expects Open in New Tab among its items, sending `openRecordInNewTab` with the record's ID.

title: Closing the active tab activates its right neighbor, or else the left; closing the last leaves one on the product; cycling wraps
when: Cycles three tabs both ways past each end, closes the active first tab, an inactive tab, the rightmost and the last.
then: Expects cycling to wrap, the right neighbor active after the first close, the active tab kept after closing an inactive one, the left neighbor after the rightmost, and one tab on the product after the last. Unknown keys change nothing.

title: Closing by button, middle-click or the close command activates the right neighbor or else the left, and the last tab leaves one on the product
when: The desktop app's bridge, with three tabs. Activates the middle tab and closes it with the close command, middle-clicks the rightmost, then closes the last by its button.
then: Expects the right neighbor and its address after the first close, the left neighbor after the second, and one tab on the product after the last.

title: Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycle, and on the focused strip the arrow keys move and Delete closes
when: The desktop app's bridge, with three tabs. Presses Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab, focuses the strip, presses the arrow keys, Enter and Delete.
then: Expects the tab commands in the keymap; the tabs to cycle; only the active tab in the Tab order, the arrow keys to move focus, Enter to activate and Delete to close the focused tab, with focus left on the tab now active; and the active tab's close button to carry the close command's keys.

title: The address follows the active tab, clicked or cycled
when: The desktop app's bridge. Opens a record, opens another in a new tab, clicks the first tab, then presses Ctrl+Tab.
then: Expects the address to name the active tab's place each time.

title: Each tab keeps its own stage, depth, filters, wiki card and scroll; the layout is the window's
when: The desktop app's bridge. In one tab sets depth 2, hides a kind, expands and scrolls the wiki card and switches to the ERD; opens a new tab and changes its depth, stage, card and the layout; returns to the first tab.
then: Expects the new tab to start on the ERD at depth 2 with the kind hidden and its card at the top; the first tab back on its own stage, depth, filters, card and scroll; and the layout the one last set, in every tab.

title: Each tab keeps its own camera on the Graph and the Trace, taken back at once when it is active again
when: The desktop app's bridge. In one tab pans the Graph's camera; opens a new tab and pans there; returns to the first tab; then does the same on the Trace stage.
then: Expects each tab's camera to be its own, and the first tab's camera, on the Graph and on the Trace, back as it was when the tab is active again.

title: Each space keeps its own tabs: switching spaces swaps the tab set
when: The desktop app's bridge. Opens two tabs in one product's space, moves to another product's page.
then: Expects only its tab, then switches back by the rail and expects the first space's two tabs again.

title: Tabs and space pages saved at anything but a page's address are dropped, not converted
when: Saves a tab set with two tabs at bare IDs and two under `/records` and `/specs`, and a space's last page under `/specs`, opens the app.
then: Expects only the two tabs at bare IDs, written back that way, and the space's rail link at its product.

title: Reloading brings back every tab with its place and history
when: The desktop app's bridge. Moves one tab through two records onto the Trace stage, opens a view in a new tab on the ERD stage, activates the first, and reloads the app at its address.
then: Expects both tabs back, the first active on the Trace stage with Back stepping to its first record, and the second, activated, back on `?stage=erd`.

title: Each tab shows its record's ID and title, a group's tab its label, never in italics
when: The desktop app's bridge. Opens a record, then a group in a new tab.
then: Expects the record's tab with its ID in mono and its title, labeling the tab panel; the group's tab with its label and no ID; and no tab in italics.

title: has View › Tabs: new, close, duplicate, next, previous, back and forward, with Cmd+T, Cmd+W, Ctrl+Tab, Cmd+[ and Cmd+] owned by the menu
when: Builds the desktop menu and clicks each item of View › Tabs.
then: Checks View › Tabs with New Tab, Close Tab, Duplicate Tab, Show Next Tab, Show Previous Tab, Back and Forward, each sent by command ID; Cmd+T, Cmd+W, Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+Shift+Tab, Cmd+[ and Cmd+] owned by the menu; and File › Close Window on Cmd+Shift+W.

title: Every focus has an ERD stage: a domain, an aggregate or an entity frames its own box, any other record its nearest entity or aggregate, or its domain or product
when: Works out the ERD focus of a domain, an aggregate, an entity, a use case, a command, its handler, an event, a table, a group, a Shared value object and the product, frames each on the laid-out map, then opens a use case and an aggregate.
then: Expects every focus to frame something on the one map; the ERD button pressed and enabled on a use case, the domain's boxes in focus; and Ctrl+2 and Alt+G switching an aggregate between the ERD and Graph stages.

title: The wiki card shows the focus's page, draws once where quick moves settle, collapses by Enter and its button, and keeps its width for the session
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage, steps right and down quickly with the arrow keys, presses Enter twice on the page, clicks the card's collapse button, moves its handle to End, opens another record and double-clicks the handle.
then: Expects the card on the use case's page with its title as an h2; after the quick steps the card not yet on the settled page, then on it; Enter hiding and showing the card and the collapse button hiding it with focus on the page bar's toggle, each kept in the place's view; the width 900 px saved in the session settings, set on the layout and kept on the next record; and double-click resetting it.

title: In the browser, the wiki card never gets narrower than 360 px: as the window narrows it collapses for space first, and its title never breaks inside a word
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage at 1920 px and resizes the window to 1440, 1100, 960 and back to 1920 px.
then: Expects nothing collapsed in a wide window, the wiki card collapsed for space as the window narrows, and everything back at 1920 px; the card at least 360 px and the open space at least 300 px wherever they show; and no line of the card's title ending inside a word.

title: The wiki card sits in one spot under the tools, inset, its height a steady share of the stage, round, its whole border in the box's color, a lifting shadow and a quiet cross-fade
when: Reads the stylesheet.
then: Expects the card's top at the stage's tools' foot plus the card's own gap, with no glide and no bottom, its right inset by its gap; its height 60% of the stage as a summary and 85% expanded, each kept above the foot, with no height limit from its content; the sheet's radius, at least three times a box's, and a 2 px border all round in the focused box's color with no top stripe, the deeper shadow, the system's text color for the border under forced colors and the cross-fade only without reduced motion; and both gaps 28 px.

title: In the browser, the wiki card holds one spot under the toolbar, about 60% of the stage high as a summary and 85% expanded, whatever the focus
when: Opens an aggregate on the Graph stage at 1440 by 900 px, steps the focus right with the arrow keys, drags the stage up, then clicks More.
then: Expects the card's top just under the stage's toolbar and its height about 60% of the stage; its top, height and right edge unchanged after the new focus and the pan; and, expanded, its top unchanged and its height larger, at most about 85% of the stage and above the foot.

title: The Enter guard leaves a plain Enter with each control that handles it, and gives it to the wiki card everywhere else
when: Asks the guard about a link, a button, a summary, fields, editable text, the button, link, menu item, option, tab, checkbox, switch, tree item and grid cell roles, a menu, listbox, combobox, tree and grid with something inside, a modal dialog, a graph box, a scrolling region, text, a link with no address and the page.
then: Expects every control and what is inside the containers to keep Enter, and the graph box, the region, the text, the link with no address and the page to give it to the card.

title: Enter toggles the wiki card from the page and the focused box, focuses another box and stays with a button; Escape collapses it after what is above it
when: On a use case on the Graph stage, presses Enter twice on the page, twice on the focus's box, once on another drawn box and once on the stage switch's button; opens quick find, presses Escape in it, then Escape twice on the page.
then: Expects Enter on the page and on the focus's box to collapse and show the card, keyboard focus kept on the box; Enter on the other box to focus it with the card left open; the button's Enter to leave the card; the first Escape to close quick find only, the next to collapse the card, and the last to do nothing.

title: In the browser, Enter on the focused box toggles the wiki card, and Escape collapses it once quick find has closed
when: On a record page on the Graph stage, focuses the focus's box and presses Enter twice; opens quick find and presses Escape twice.
then: Expects the card collapsed and shown with keyboard focus kept on the box, quick find closed with the card still open after the first Escape, and the card collapsed and announced after the second.

title: A card page drawn or left mid-fade while the window is hidden ends its fade at once and shows whole
when: Draws a card page while the window is hidden; draws another while it is shown, then hides the window; then lets the page go and hides the window again.
then: Expects the first page's fade ended at once, the second's fade left running while shown and ended once hidden, and nothing ended after the page was let go.

title: The panels take the frosted surfaces, opaque under reduced transparency, and each says the side it floats on
when: Reads the stylesheet and opens a use case on the Graph stage.
then: Expects the dense and light surfaces to be the sheet's color at about 82% and 80% with a 22 px blur, the light one at least 78% and below the dense one, the sheet itself with no blur under reduced transparency, the wiki card and the dense panels to take their surface and the blur, and the nav, page bar, header strip and wiki card to float on the left, top, top and right; and text keeping 4.5:1 on the dense panels and 4.8:1 on the card in every built-in theme and mode, over every fill and dense content.

title: Stability: in a browser every panel blurs the stage behind a see-through surface, and draws opaque with no blur under reduced transparency
when: Opens a record on the Graph stage, reads each panel's computed backdrop filter and background, then emulates reduced transparency.
then: Expects the nav, page bar, header strip and wiki card each to blur with a translucent background, then each to draw no blur on an opaque background.

title: Performance: with every panel open, scrolling the wiki card moves no camera, and collapsing it recenters the graph within the camera move budget
when: Opens a record on the Graph stage on the production build with the nav, tab panel and wiki card open, scrolls the wiki card halfway, then presses Enter on the page to collapse the card.
then: Expects no camera move from the scroll, and the glide that recenters the graph to take under the camera move budget of main-thread work.

title: The wiki card opens as a summary, More shows the whole page in place and Less goes back, the place's own
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage in a new place, then clicks More and Less.
then: Expects the summary first: the kind line, the title as an h2, the goal and at most three facts, its capability first, with Edit and without the page's sections; after More the whole page with its flows and Edit, kept as expanded in the place's view; after Less the summary again, kept too.

title: The leader line runs from the focused box's nearest edge to the card, level with its title, or stubs toward a box out of view
when: Works out the line for a 100 by 40 box under three cameras, for a box spanning the title's row, a box running under a panel, boxes above, left of and past a corner of the open space, a box above with a tool row in the frame, and with no box, no card or no open space.
then: Expects the line from the box's nearest point to the card's inner edge at its title's row, slanting when they are not level; its start following a pan and a zoom while its end stays; a box under a panel starting at the open space's edge; a 28 px stub ending 12 px inside the frame's edge toward a box out of view; and no line with no box, no card or no open space.

title: In the browser, on the Graph, ERD and Trace stages, the leader line joins the focused box to the card's title, follows a pan, stubs for a box out of view and goes with the card
when: Opens an aggregate on the Graph and ERD stages and a use case on the Trace stage at 1440 px, drags the stage a little, then far, then presses Enter on the page; and opens the aggregate at phone width.
then: Expects the line to end on the card's inner edge within the title's row, its end unchanged and its start moved by the small pan, a stub after the far pan, no line once the card is collapsed, and no line on a phone.

title: In the browser, a pan of the Graph with the leader line drawn every frame stays within the camera-move budget
when: Opens an aggregate on the Graph stage with the wiki card open and drags the stage 80 px in 20 steps.
then: Expects the line drawn before and after the pan, and the pan's main-thread work within the camera-move budget (LA-PAT-APP-UX-R11).

title: In the wiki card's summary a long value wraps at the card's width, its label column only as wide as its labels
when: Reads the stylesheet's rules for the wiki card summary's fact rows and record links.
then: Expects the summary's fact rows to size the label column to its content and give the value the rest, and a record link in a value to flow inline.

title: History in the wiki card lists the commits that touched the record's rows, the uncommitted change first, shows a commit's diff inline, loads more, and says calmly when there is no git
when: Expands the wiki card with the history API answered in the test, and presses "Show the history".
then: Expects no history read before the button is pressed; then "Not committed" first and twenty commits with date, author and short hash; the uncommitted diff inline with its removed, added and header lines marked; one diff open at a time; Load more adding the rest; and the calm message when the folder is not a git repository.

title: A changed record's wiki card lists each field old → new and the links added and removed, an added one says New since its baseline, and the summary says it in a line
when: Opens a command with the wiki card folded, lands an edit that retitles it and adds another command, then presses More on the card.
then: Expects the folded card's summary line to say the record changed since the last commit and name the title field, and More to show the card's Changes section.

title: The Graph, the ERD and the Trace each show Highlight changes, the baseline picker, Follow and the panel toggle in one place
when: Opens an aggregate on the Graph, ERD and Trace stages in turn and reads the Changes group in each.
then: Expects the Changes group in the shared stage toolbar right after Frame on every stage, the same controls in the same order on all three, and its buttons Highlight changes, Follow and Changes.

title: Accessibility: the Changes controls and the Changes panel pass axe at WCAG 2.2 AA
when: In Chromium, at desktop and phone widths in every look, opens a record on the Graph stage with the Changes panel open, turns Highlight changes on, and runs axe.
then: Expects no axe violations at WCAG 2.2 AA in the Changes controls with Highlight changes on and in the Changes panel, showing its empty answer.

title: Each stage marks added, changed and removed records, dots only under reduced motion, and Highlight changes puts a pill, a roll-up and the one fade on them without a new layout
when: Opens an aggregate on the ERD stage and lands a retitle of it, then lands another with reduced motion on.
then: Expects the ERD's box for the aggregate marked changed with its dot and its flash, and under reduced motion the dot without the flash; with Highlight changes on, the ERD's changed box carrying a Changed pill and its region the roll-up.

title: Performance: marking 50 changes at once stays within the frame budget
when: On the production build, opens a domain on the Graph stage and retitles 50 of its drawn records in one CLI write, as an Agent writes, then puts them back.
then: Expects all 50 boxes marked changed within 500 ms of main-thread work, recording the longest frame and the frames over 20 ms.

title: Accessibility: the New, Changed and Removed pills read at AA in every look and both modes
when: Reads each built-in theme's tokens in light and dark (with Lathe's own for a token it leaves out) and works out the pill colors as the stylesheet derives them.
then: Expects each pill's text on its fill, and its color as text on the sheet, to be at least 4.5:1.

title: Performance: with Highlight changes on, marking 50 changes at once, with their pills and roll-ups, stays within the frame budget
when: On the production build, opens a domain on the Graph stage, turns Highlight changes on and retitles 50 of its drawn records in one CLI write, as an Agent writes, then puts them back.
then: Expects all 50 boxes carrying the Changed pill within 500 ms of main-thread work, recording the longest frame and the frames over 20 ms.

title: Every stage shows its key as one bar along the bottom with only what it draws
when: On a use case, opens the Graph stage, then the ERD, then the Trace, and reads each stage's key.
then: Expects the key on each stage a floating panel at the bottom, one tab stop outside the toolbar, with no Key in the toolbar; on the Graph exactly the use cases' color, the focus, the slice, stadium and page shapes, the parent line, a bar, the gap badge and what scroll does, the use case entry reading `Use case` with the tooltip `Use case: a stadium`; the ERD's domain, aggregate, entity and has-many line entries; and the Trace's columns, reaches link, focus and faded entries, ending with `Scroll pans`.

title: Each tab has its own Back and Forward: a move drops the forward entries, Back and Forward step within the tab
when: Moves one of two tabs through three pages, steps Back twice, moves to a fourth page, and steps Forward and Back in each tab.
then: Expects Back to step through the tab's own entries, the move after Back to drop the forward entries, Forward then to do nothing, and stepping never to reach the other tab's entries or change the active tab.

title: Back and Forward step through the active tab's history, and switching tabs gives the window the new tab's history
when: The desktop app's bridge, with two tabs each moved through two records. Goes Back in the second tab, activates the first, goes Back and Forward there, then activates the second again.
then: Expects Back in each tab to land on that tab's own previous record, the window's history to hold the active tab's entries after each switch, and the address to name the active tab's place.

title: On the web there is no tab strip, and a move pushes the browser's own history
when: Opens a record in the web app, clicks a box, follows a link and goes Back.
then: Expects no tab strip, no Open pages button and no tab commands; one browser history entry per move; and Back returning to the record before.

title: On the web, Cmd or Ctrl+click and middle-click on a box open its address in a new browser tab
when: Cmd+clicks, Ctrl+clicks and middle-clicks a box on the stage in the web app.
then: Expects each to open the box's address in a new browser tab and leave the current place unchanged.

title: On the web, the stage, depth, filters and wiki card are the browser tab's own, kept through a reload
when: In the web app, switches to the ERD, sets depth 2, hides a kind, expands the wiki card, then reloads at the same address.
then: Expects the stage in the address, the depth, filters and card kept in the browser tab's session storage, and all of them back after the reload.

title: A link in the wiki card re-centers the graph and the header strip, and a click on the stage moves the card
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage at depth 2, follows a requirement's link in the wiki card, then clicks the requirement's sibling on the stage.
then: Expects the address, the header strip's title, the graph's center and the card's text on the requirement; then the address `?stage=graph`, the card and the center on the sibling.

title: The stage a link names opens and is remembered, so a new session's first page opens on it
when: Opens a use case with `?stage=trace`, clears the session and opens another record with no stage.
then: Expects `trace` remembered as the stage, and the other record opening on the Trace stage with Graph not pressed.

title: Opening, activating, cycling and closing tabs never touch the window's settings; only the person's change does
when: The session's settings set to Nested with the minimap on, and the tab's depth 2. Opens a page in the tab, opens another in a new tab, activates the first, cycles and closes tabs; then changes the settings.
then: Expects the session's settings unchanged after every tab move and no tab's place to hold them; the change alone changes them.

title: The Graph's containers show their roll-ups, the nav its counts, and the minimap and the edge hints point to changes out of view
when: Reloads the data with a command renamed and one added, turns Highlight changes on, and reads the Graph's scene and the nav.
then: Expects the entity's box to carry the roll-up "1 new · 1 changed" and the nav the counts beside the domain.

title: The Trace's All-at-once view gives a new record its pill, dims the rest and rolls each column's changes up in its header
when: Opens the product's Trace with an outcome added since the baseline and turns Highlight changes on.
then: Expects the outcome's box to carry the New pill at full strength, every other box dimmed to a fifth, and the first column's header to say "1 new".

title: The products picker is the space chooser
when: Opens `/` in a workspace with two products, presses Escape, opens a product from the picker, opens `/` again and presses Escape.
then: Expects a Products dialog over an empty stage with one card per product (`/DM`, `/NF`) showing its mark, ID, name and domain count and no problems or coverage; Escape on the first launch leaving the picker open; the Notebook link opening `/NF`; and, reopened, the picker over that product's stage with Notebook marked current and Escape returning to `/NF`.

title: Trace works on every focus: Ctrl+3 or the switch shows it, never disabled, on an obligation, above one, and on a record no chain holds
when: Switches an aggregate from the ERD to the Trace stage with Ctrl+3 and back with Alt+E, then opens a test, a flow step and a term on the Trace stage.
then: Expects the aggregate's matrix after Ctrl+3 and `?stage=erd` after Alt+E, and on each other record the Trace button pressed and enabled among Graph, ERD and Trace, with a trace drawn.

title: An obligation's chain holds what designs, builds and proves it, and the files they name, as the engine works it out
when: Works out, with the engine, the chains of a UC requirement, an invariant, a constraint and a pattern rule, and of records that are no obligation.
then: Expects a UC requirement's step, flow, view and command in design, the command's handler and the UI component rendering the view in build, its test, and their files; an invariant's aggregate and enforcing table; a constraint's value object and value type; a pattern rule's tests in each domain; and nothing for a record that is no obligation.

title: An obligation's Trace stage draws the five columns, each record once, the obligation as the focus in view with what links to it
when: Opens a UC requirement on the Trace stage.
then: Expects the canvas ready with the five columns named, every record drawn once, the requirement as the focus and in view, its use case in the column to its left and its handler and test in the columns to its right, the chains read from list-traces, and its kind and counts in the header strip.

title: The graph's columns hold the outcomes, use cases, every obligation kind, what builds them and their tests, each record once
when: Works out the All-at-once graph of the model product with an outcome its capability serves.
then: Expects the outcome in the first column, the use cases in the second, each obligation of every kind in the third, the records building them in the fourth and their tests in the fifth, every record in one column once, and the gaps after the records in theirs.

title: The order keeps linked boxes near and no two boxes in a column overlap
when: Lays out columns whose ID order crosses their links, with boxes under an outcome and boxes under none.
then: Expects fewer crossing links than in ID order, every box at least a row below the one above it in its column, and the boxes under an outcome above the rest.

title: Each link is a line of its kind between columns; a record two use cases reach has two lines and one box
when: Opens a use case on the Trace stage with a pattern rule both its use cases reach.
then: Expects a serves line from the outcome to the use case, reaches lines from the use case to its obligations, built by and proved by lines from a requirement to its handler and test, and the rule drawn once with a reaches line from each use case.

title: The links come from the Trace read model: serves, reaches, built by and proved by
when: Works out the All-at-once graph of the model product with an outcome its capability serves.
then: Expects a serves link from the outcome to each of the capability's use cases, a reaches link from each use case to each obligation it reaches, a built by link from each obligation to each record building it and a proved by link to each test, each once.

title: A row's gaps are the ones coverage reports: not designed, not built, not proved; a pattern rule owes proof only
when: Works out the chains of a traced requirement, an unproved requirement, an unproved invariant, a specification coverage reports not built and not designed, and a pattern rule.
then: Expects a fully traced requirement with no gap, an unproved requirement and invariant with a gap in tests, a specification with the design and build gaps coverage reports, and a pattern rule that owes proof only with its tests gap.

title: Gap cells show in the table, the header strip counts them, and Gaps only keeps those rows and the gaps' paths
when: Opens a domain on the Trace stage and checks Gaps only, then does the same on a use case whose every requirement is traced.
then: Expects gap cells in the warning style, the count of obligations and of those with gaps in the header strip, after Gaps only only the rows with a gap, and on the canvas every box still drawn in its place, each obligation with a gap and its path at full strength, the rest faded, each gap a dashed box; then a note when no row has one.

title: A gap is a dashed box in its column, linked from its obligation, and Gaps only keeps the gaps' paths
when: Works out the All-at-once graph of the model product, with a specification coverage reports not built and not proved, and what Gaps only keeps.
then: Expects a Not built gap under Built by and a Not proved gap under Proved by, each linked from the specification, none for a traced requirement, and Gaps only keeping the specification's whole path and not a complete requirement's.

title: Every cell links to its record and shows its ID, never wrapped, and its title; a file links to the record that names it
when: Opens a UC requirement on the Trace stage and reads its chain's file link, opens its domain's matrix and reads a cell's link and the stylesheet, then clicks a step's link in the chain.
then: Expects a file to link to the record that names it, keeping the Trace stage, with the path and that record in its tooltip; a matrix cell's link to show the record's ID and title with both in its tooltip; the ID never wrapped, the title cut with an ellipsis and the matrix sized to its content; and a click moving the focus.

title: A click on a box opens its record, keeping the stage; a gap opens nothing
when: Opens a UC requirement on the Trace stage, clicks its test's box, then clicks a gap's box.
then: Expects the click on the test's box to open the test on the Trace stage, and the click on the gap's box to leave the focus where it was.

title: A long matrix draws 100 rows and adds 100 at a time
when: Adds 120 requirements to a use case, opens it on the Trace stage, and presses Show more.
then: Expects a matrix of more than 100 obligations to draw 100 rows with a count of those shown, and Show more to add the next ones.

title: Performance: the first frame of the product's All-at-once view within its budget, every switch and focus after it within the stage switch budget
when: On a use case's page switches to the Trace stage once (loading its code and laying the product's view out), then again; then focuses the product from a domain's Trace stage and drags across the view, over this repo's own spec.
then: Expects the first switch within the first-frame budget, the second switch and the product's focus with its table's first page and its Untraced section within the stage switch budget, and the drag within the frame budget.

title: Fitting the whole product draws bars, at most 260 boxes
when: Opens the model product on the Trace stage and presses the camera's Fit.
then: Expects at most 260 boxes drawn and the runs too small to see drawn as bars.

title: Untraced lists the records coverage reports untraced under the focus, by kind
when: Lists, with the engine, what is untraced under a domain, a use case and Interaction design, then again once the untraced step fulfills a requirement.
then: Expects the engine's record-untraced step and commands under the domain, grouped by kind, each a gap coverage reports; nothing for a container, a flow test or a record a chain reaches; and nothing once the step fulfills a requirement.

title: The table ends with its Untraced section, counted in the header strip and kept by Gaps only
when: Opens a domain on the Trace stage and checks Gaps only, then opens a use case whose every record is reached.
then: Expects the section's records as links grouped by kind, keeping the Trace stage, their count in the header strip, the section still there under Gaps only, and its empty note where everything is reached.

title: What no outcome reaches sits at the bottom of its column, under its mark
when: Works out the All-at-once graph and its layout with a use case whose capability serves nothing and a requirement only it reaches.
then: Expects the use case and the requirement under no outcome, below the mark's top in their columns, and every box an outcome reaches above it.

title: A held record shows the rows that hold it marked, an untraced one says so over the rows around it, and an entity shows its aggregate's rows
when: Opens on the Trace stage a command a chain holds, a test, a command nothing traces to and an entity.
then: Expects the held command's one row with the command marked in its cell and "1 obligation holds this record" in the header strip; the test marked in its obligation's row; for the untraced command "Nothing traces to this record: it serves no requirement or rule." above its aggregate's matrix, the command marked in the Untraced section; and for the entity its aggregate's matrix with no untraced warning, said to sit outside every chain.

title: A box's path goes both ways from it only
when: Works out the path of a use case, a requirement and a test in the All-at-once graph.
then: Expects a use case's path to hold its outcomes, its obligations and what builds and proves them but no other use case; a test's its obligation, the use cases reaching it and their outcomes; and the links lit between them.

title: Focusing an outcome lights its path and fades the rest; hovering a box lights its path
when: Opens an outcome on the Trace stage, then hovers a test's box.
then: Expects the outcome's use cases, their obligations and what builds and proves them at full strength and lit, every other box faded; and hovering the test to light its obligation, the use cases reaching it and their outcomes.

title: Stability: focusing an outcome and a test lights their paths both ways; hovering lights a path
when: Opens an outcome of this repo's data on the Trace stage, then a test, then hovers a requirement's box.
then: Expects the outcome's path lit to its tests and the rest faded, the test's path lit back to its outcomes, and the hovered requirement's path lit.

title: The walk goes up and down a column and along the links left and right
when: Walks the All-at-once graph of the model product from a requirement, a use case and from no box.
then: Expects Up and Down to the boxes above and below in the column, Right to the nearest linked box in the next column that way, Left to its use case, and from no box any move to the first outcome.

title: The table under the canvas carries the keyboard: a focused link rings its box, and the arrow keys walk the table
when: Opens a use case on the Trace stage, focuses its requirement P-D-UC01-R01's link, presses Right, then focuses the requirement's row link and presses Down.
