then: Expects the canvas hidden from assistive technology and the table visually hidden under it; focusing the requirement's link to draw its box with the focus ring; Right to move to the next link, Down to the same cell of the next row.

title: A matrix has one row per obligation under the focus, in the nav's order, grouped by parent
when: Builds the trace matrix of a use case, a domain, a domain's stage, the product and a test, and the trace shape of records of each kind.
then: Expects a use case's requirements under it, a domain's obligations grouped by their parents, a stage's and the product's too, and each of them drawn as a matrix.

title: A business outcome's matrix is the obligations under the capabilities serving it
when: Works out the Trace stage's shape for an outcome its capability serves and one nothing serves.
then: Expects the served outcome's matrix to hold the obligations under the capability in the tree's order, and the other outcome the matrix around it.

title: Scroll pans, Cmd/Ctrl+scroll zooms and a drag pans the trace's camera, and . frames the focus again with a glide, as on the graph
when: Opens a use case on the Trace stage, scrolls the canvas, scrolls with Ctrl held, drags the canvas, then presses `.`.
then: Expects a scroll to pan the camera by its pixels with the zoom unchanged, Ctrl with the wheel to zoom in, a drag to move the camera, the Frame the focus button to carry ., and . to bring the camera back to the focus's frame.

title: One layout: focusing two records and Gaps only move the camera and fade, never a box; a stage switch lands on the focus
when: Switches a requirement from the Graph to the Trace stage with Ctrl+3, then focuses another requirement and a use case from the table, then turns on Gaps only.
then: Expects the requirement drawn as the focus and in view after the switch; the camera moved at each focus; every box at the same place and size throughout; and a complete requirement faded under Gaps only.

title: A new layout keeps the order shown before; Tidy up orders afresh
when: Lays out some columns, then again with one box added and one removed given the order before, then again with no order before.
then: Expects every kept box in the same order, the new box in at its barycenter, and the layout with no order before ordered afresh.

title: A change keeps every column's order on the Trace's All-at-once view
when: Lays out the model product's All-at-once view, then adds, removes, renames and moves a record and lays it out again given the order before.
then: Expects every column's kept boxes in the order shown before, an added requirement placed and a removed one gone.

title: The switch shows All at once and offers Delivery once built; the place keeps its view
when: Opens a use case on the Trace stage.
then: Expects the All at once | Delivery switch with All at once pressed and Delivery not built yet, and the place's view to be All at once.

title: On a phone the Trace stage is one column at a time with the focus's links
when: Opens a requirement on the Trace stage at a phone's width and picks another column.
then: Expects no canvas, the requirement's column shown first with the requirement's links listed above it by kind, and the column picked shown instead.

title: The chat floats at the right, measured by the stage, and its toggle and key show and hide it
when: With the desktop app's chat faked, opens a use case, presses Hide the chat, then presses the chat's key (Ctrl+Alt+C off a Mac).
then: Expects the chat floating at the right with the app laid out for it, Hide the chat to remove it and store the choice in the session, and the key to show it again with the message box focused and the toggle pressed.

title: The chat by keyboard: focus its message box, send, stop, and walk the messages
when: In Chromium, on a record with a chat, presses Ctrl+Alt+C three times, types two lines with Shift+Enter and sends with Enter, presses Escape, Shift+Tabs to the log and presses Up, Home and End, then Tabs to a permission prompt's Allow once and presses Enter.
then: Expects the key to focus the message box, hide the chat with "Chat hidden" announced and show it again focused; Enter to send both lines and Claude to start working; Escape to stop the turn with focus kept in the box; the log's one tab stop on the last message, the keys walking the messages; and Enter on Allow once to answer the prompt.

title: The head shows the Lathe tools, the mode menu and Bypass's warning and badge; the empty chat says when Claude Code cannot answer
when: With the desktop app's chat faked, pushes a chat with its tools loaded, loading and failed; opens the mode menu and chooses View only by keyboard and pointer; chooses Bypass, cancels the warning, then turns it on; and opens the chat with Claude Code not signed in, and not found.
then: Expects "142 tools from Lathe 2.0.0", the loading and failed notes; the five modes in order, the current one checked, View only sent and shown; the warning before Bypass, nothing sent on Cancel, the mode sent on Turn on Bypass and the badge once the chat is in it; the not-signed-in message with `/login`, New session disabled and no message sent; and the install link.

title: The mic button dictates into the message box; the Voice menu turns on voice activation and Quick mode
when: With the desktop app's chat and voice faked, dictates and sends; turns on voice activation and Quick mode and saves clashing, then good, phrases; dictates before the microphone was ever asked for; lets Quick mode count down and presses a key; and opens the chat where dictation is not available.
then: Expects the heard words in the box and sent, the modes and phrases kept in local storage and a clash refused with its reason, the note before listening, the countdown on Send canceled by the key, and no mic or Voice menu where it is not available.

title: The chat panel draws the picker, queue, chips, images, skills and review
when: With the desktop chat faked, attaches a record, pastes an image, queues a message, types a slash, chooses a model and reviews a turn.
then: Expects each part drawn where the panel puts it and gone when it is done with.
